title: Demand Planner - North
description:
1. Demand Aggregation and Planning: Aggregate the regional demands and analyses the same to share final unconstrained demand for source and inventory planning team.
2. S&OP Coordination and Planning: Facilitate communication and collaboration between various departments, such as sales, marketing, production, and higher management using S&OP process to ensure that demand plans align with business objectives.
3. Demand Planning Improvements: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the demand planning process, implementing advanced forecasting techniques and best practices.
4. Inventory Management: Manage inventory levels by balancing customer demand with available stock, setting reorder points, and optimizing safety stock levels to prevent stockouts or excess inventory.
5. Long Term Planning: Align and coordinate with marketing and sales to share long term business plan of various products for capacity alignment and resource planning.
6. Market Analysis: Coordinate with marketing and sales to understand market conditions and external factors such as price change, schemes/promotions and discuss current market trends for onward corrections

title: AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability
description:
Job Description
Purpose of the role
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
Accountabilities
Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.
Assistant Vice President Expectations
To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:
Essential Skills and Qualifications:
Manage change to data platforms.
Perform incident triage for platform issues.
Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
Championing the features that the business need.
Translating complex technology into consumable business language.
Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.
Desirable skills/Preferred Qualifications:
Communication
Problem solving
SQL
Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.
This role will be based out of Gurugram.

description:
About the role
AI Specialists don’t get better by accident. Hill climbing is how we improve them. We test against real customer environments, find what’s failing, fix it, and test again. Now we want every AI Specialist team to climb this way, faster, and without needing us to run it for them. You’ll own the product and the program that make that happen.
What you’ll do
Own the hill climbing product roadmap and scale it across our priority AI Specialists and beyond.
Run the customer instance program with our business units and product teams, expanding access to real customer environments so every specialist is tested where it actually runs.
Cut the loop time from a shipped change to a clear, actionable quality verdict from weeks to days.
Convert eval findings into prioritized fixes with specialist product teams, and stay with those teams until the fixes ship.
Turn hill climbing into a method product teams can run on their own, with the tools, guides and defaults to do it well and without heavy support from our team.
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

title: Senior Product Designer (AI Builder)
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
About the Role
This role exists because we believe the future of design is fundamentally agentic. You're not here to use AI as a productivity tool - you're here to redesign the entire practice of design itself. Part engineer, part designer, part systems architect, entirely at the frontier.
Roles & Responsibilities
Set the new standard : Be the living proof of AI-native design workflows. Build remarkable things, show them to the team.
Build the stack : Ship projects that progressively automate the design process - from discrete tools to full end-to-end automation.
Enable the org : Build AI workflows that 60 designers can run end-to-end - independently, without bottlenecks. Raise the floor.
Find the friction : Research where designers get stuck. Turn those observations into tools, agents, and systems.
Stay ahead : Maintain frontier knowledge of AI possibilities. Not as a hobby - as a core job function
You are an Ideal fit, if you are
Top percentile in AI × Design  : You apply AI to product design workflows better than almost anyone. You've proven it.
Credible designer and builder : You have taste and you ship. Both matter equally here.
Exceptional communicator : Whether 1:1 or to a group - you make complex ideas land simply.
Systems thinker : You solve entire classes of problems, not individual tasks.
Obsessively curious : Dissatisfied with what exists. Energised by what's next.
What You Get :
Virtually unlimited AI compute budget.
Work with 60 talented designers who are eager to transform.
Direct access to Design, Product, and Company leadership -zero bureaucracy.
Full independence to build and experiment.
Authority to drive adoption - if it's worth doing, it will happen.
The most interesting AI-design infrastructure problem in global tech.

title: Manager, Customer Experience, APAC
description:
Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
Role Overview
Harvey is looking for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager to lead a high-performing support team serving lawyers and professional services teams. Our customers hold their own work to a high standard of accuracy and timeliness, and expect the same from our support. How well your region runs is one of the biggest levers Harvey has on what customers actually experience when they need help. Reporting to the Head of CX, you'll drive operational excellence and accountability across Harvey's global support organization.
You'll balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution. This is a role for a leader who thrives in motion: proactive, decisive, and deeply motivated by achieving results through your team. You'll inherit a metric set and processes that need to be better, and we expect you to diagnose what's broken and fix it without being asked.
You'll also be one of five CX Managers across the globe, and that peer group is where our operating standard gets set. You're expected to trade what's working across regions and push for the changes you think we should make everywhere, shaping the culture and cadence of a growing support organization.
What You'll Do
Run day-to-day support delivery for your region: queue and coverage, triage and handoff, and escalation judgment, measured by First Response Time, Resolution Time, QA, and cSAT. When a number moves, you find the root cause and fix it or scale it.
Set individual performance expectations and stay close enough to the work to spot drift early. Coach against QA results in the moment, and move to a documented plan only when coaching hasn't landed.
Own escalations end to end: triage and severity judgment, customer communication through to resolution, and bug reports Engineering can act on without a follow-up thread. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to turn recurring escalations into fixes.
Take part in the on-call rotation for customer-impacting incidents, owning the coordination of response and customer communication strategy while an incident is live.
Drive adoption of the AI tools and systems we provide across triage, drafting, deflection, and QA, and pressure-test what CX Ops ships against real queue conditions.
Track how your region performs against the other four, bring what's working to your peers, adopt what's working in theirs, and propose the practices you think should apply globally.
Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.
Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs
What You Have
10+ years in customer support or customer experience, including 4+ years managing teams in a high-volume environment serving enterprise customers.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is looking for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager to lead a high-performing support team serving lawyers and professional services teams. Our customers hold their own work to a high standard of accuracy and timeliness, and expect the same from our support. How well your region runs is one of the biggest levers Harvey has on what customers actually experience when they need help. Reporting to the Head of CX, you'll drive operational excellence and accountability across Harvey's global support organization.

You'll balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution. This is a role for a leader who thrives in motion: proactive, decisive, and deeply motivated by achieving results through your team. You'll inherit a metric set and processes that need to be better, and we expect you to diagnose what's broken and fix it without being asked.

You'll also be one of five CX Managers across the globe, and that peer group is where our operating standard gets set. You're expected to trade what's working across regions and push for the changes you think we should make everywhere, shaping the culture and cadence of a growing support organization.

What You'll Do

  • Run day-to-day support delivery for your region: queue and coverage, triage and handoff, and escalation judgment, measured by First Response Time, Resolution Time, QA, and cSAT. When a number moves, you find the root cause and fix it or scale it.

  • Set individual performance expectations and stay close enough to the work to spot drift early. Coach against QA results in the moment, and move to a documented plan only when coaching hasn't landed.

  • Own escalations end to end: triage and severity judgment, customer communication through to resolution, and bug reports Engineering can act on without a follow-up thread. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to turn recurring escalations into fixes.

  • Take part in the on-call rotation for customer-impacting incidents, owning the coordination of response and customer communication strategy while an incident is live.

  • Drive adoption of the AI tools and systems we provide across triage, drafting, deflection, and QA, and pressure-test what CX Ops ships against real queue conditions.

  • Track how your region performs against the other four, bring what's working to your peers, adopt what's working in theirs, and propose the practices you think should apply globally.

  • Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.

  • Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs

What You Have

  • 10+ years in customer support or customer experience, including 4+ years managing teams in a high-volume environment serving enterprise customers.

  • Comfortable operating at Harvey's pace, not a typical enterprise pace. This is consistently the hardest bar for otherwise-strong support managers to clear.

  • A deep focus on the customer, and real satisfaction in solving the problems that make their work harder than it needs to be.

  • You are genuinely invested in developing your team, and you know a high bar is part of that.

  • You manage close to the work. You know what your team's tickets actually look like, not just what the dashboard says.

  • A change you made to how a support team works that produced a step change, not an incremental gain. You saw the leverage point others in the seat missed.

  • Ownership of a metric set (FRT, TTR, cSAT, QA, backlog, deflection): what drives each one, what to change when one slips, and the ability to build your own reporting. We use Zendesk, Salesforce, Omni, and Snowflake.

  • You understand enterprise escalations, from severity judgment through the customer conversation, and can work one yourself: reproduce the issue, read error logs, and troubleshoot API, authentication, and AI output quality issues well enough to brief Engineering accurately.

  • You can take a process improvement from idea to shipped yourself, and you know which ones to handover to someone on your team instead.

  • Day-to-day proficiency using AI tools in a production support workflow, not experimentation, and a concrete point of view on how AI is changing what a support team should look like.

  • Admin-level fluency with Zendesk or an equivalent platform: views, triggers, macros, and routing logic.

Job Description Summary
The Manager, Digital Platform Operations is responsible for driving operational excellence across commercial digital platforms by ensuring platform stability, scalability, and disciplined execution of customer-facing programs and initiatives.
This role strengthens the platform operating environment through standardized processes, governance, and operational rigor while supporting a seamless customer lifecycle from early solution design through implementation, launch, and ongoing operations.
The position partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Product R&D, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Customer Success, and Delivery teams to translate strategic objectives into operational execution plans, maintain organizational readiness, and ensure consistent delivery outcomes.
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
Job Description
This role ensures commercial digital platforms operate effectively, customer lifecycle processes are executed consistently, and teams are equipped with the structure, governance, and operational discipline needed to deliver successful customer outcomes. The Manager serves as a key operational leader focused on scaling operations, improving execution consistency, and enabling sustainable growth across the digital platform portfolio.

Platform Operations Excellence
Support the operational management and continuous improvement of commercial digital platforms.
Drive platform stability, reliability, and scalability through standardized operating procedures and governance practices.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and implement process improvements.

Develop and maintain repeatable execution models that improve delivery predictability and customer satisfaction.
Facilitate cross-functional readiness reviews and governance meetings.
Process & Governance Management

Track program milestones, dependencies, risks, and action plans to ensure successful execution.
Support governance reviews through preparation of operational metrics, performance reporting, and status updates.
Ensure adherence to established operational standards, policies, and best practices.
Document and continuously improve operating procedures and service delivery processes.
Performance & Continuous Improvement
Analyze operational and customer performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
Drive initiatives that improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.
Support root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for operational challenges.

Promote a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

title: Executive Director - International Centre for Research on Women (ICRW) ASIA
description:
The International Centre for Research on Women (ICRW) is the world’s premier institution dedicated to advancing gender equity through rigorous research, evidence-based programming, and strategic advocacy. For nearly five decades, we’ve influenced how governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and corporations address one of the most urgent challenges of our time.
ICRW Asia operates at the intersection of
research excellence and practical implementation
- generating evidence that drives policy, designing interventions that create measurable change, and building partnerships that scale impact across communities, countries, and continents.
The Strategic Imperative
Educational gains for women are clear, yet without decisive action, gender parity will remain elusive for decades. The next Executive Director of ICRW Asia will drive the shift with  bold strategic leadership , deepening our policy influence, expanding our voice, and leading ambitious, evidence-backed programs that affect millions.
This is more than a leadership role. It is an invitation to shape the trajectory of gender equity across one of the world’s most dynamic regions.
Key Responsibilities
Provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and oversight to all ICRW Asia verticals - research and programmes, operations, finance, human resources, communications, and related management functions ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Lead and diversify fundraising activities as the chief fundraiser; develop and execute a strategy to expand the donor base across bilateral, philanthropic, multilateral, and private sector partners, securing long-term financial sustainability.
Oversee planning, budgeting, and financial management to meet short- and long-term needs; ensure robust fiscal health, accountability, and compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements across countries of operation and fundraising.
Recruit, lead, and develop a diverse, high-performing team; set and monitor transparent performance and development goals; foster a performance-oriented, inclusive, and equity-driven work culture.
Strengthen ICRW’s role as a thought leader in gender-based research and advocacy; expand programme implementation to engage new audiences; and cultivate high-value partnerships and coalitions to position ICRW as the “go-to” organization for gender research and policy influence.
Serve as chief spokesperson for ICRW Asia, representing the organization in high-profile regional and global fora; lead a consistent, impactful communications strategy across platforms and stakeholders.
Execute and sign all deeds, agreements, contracts, and official documents on behalf of ICRW Asia; maintain a transparent and productive relationship with the ICRW Asia Board to guide strategic direction and ensure adaptability in a changing environment.
Professional Experience and Qualifications Required
Master’s degree or PhD in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Administration, or related field.
15-20 years’ professional leadership experience in Asia or globally, in the non-profit, public, or private sectors  preferably in public health, international development, or gender-related issues  with a demonstrated commitment to gender equity and social justice.
Proven track record in fundraising and resource mobilization from diverse sources; strong ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships with donors, civil society, stakeholders, and the private sector.
Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary   teams in dynamic environments; prior leadership of an organization, entity, or business unit of comparable scale and complexity preferred.
Expertise in leveraging or conducting research, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible messaging for varied audiences.
Exceptional  leadership and communication skills, with experience fostering a culture grounded in diversity, equity, social justice, ethics, transparency, and accountability.
Strong business acumen with the ability to deliver measurable impact while ensuring financial health; skilled in budgeting, financial analysis, and scenario planning.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.
Evidence & Impact
Explore all research and insights :
The Culture We Offer
At ICRW Asia, we strive to create an environment that reflects our commitment to gender equity and social inclusion. The team is multidisciplinary, comprising researchers, economists, anthropologists, and advocates who work together to generate evidence-based insights and actionable policy recommendations.
We value:
Academic rigor with contextual relevance
Collaborative inquiry and thought leadership
A commitment to inclusivity, diversity, and equitable workplace practices
As a regional hub within a globally respected organization, ICRW Asia combines:
The credibility and reach of a global institution
The adaptability and local responsiveness of a regional entity
Read more about our approach and values:
Why Exceptional Leaders Choose ICRW
These reflections are drawn from feedback shared by former policy advisors, multilateral agency partners, bilateral donors, funders, and internal staff on public platforms such as Glassdoor and LinkedIn:
ICRW stands at the intersection of rigorous research and strategic advocacy - a place where data drives action and change are shaped by evidence.
When global donors and governments need more than just frameworks - when they need grounded insights and policy-aligned strategies - ICRW becomes their go-to partner.
More than an institution, ICRW Asia is a space for mission-driven inquiry. Researchers are encouraged to question, challenge, and engage deeply with systems of power and justice.
Application End Date : Sept 15th 2025

title: Technical project manager - Network infrastructure - APAC
description:
About
Nebius
:
Nebius
is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The Role
We're looking for a
Lead Technical Project Manager
for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.
The "T" matters.
You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.
The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure.
Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.
The "M" is management of execution, not people management.
You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.
This is a high-leverage role in a early-stage and fast-scaling network infrastructure organisation. Many important systems are being built now: automation, observability, reliability standards, provisioning flows, operational safety, and cross-site consistency. You won't be maintaining a mature machine from the sidelines. You'll help shape how the machine works.
Your responsibilities will include:
Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team network infrastructure initiatives in APAC, from a vague problem statement to an executable plan to adoption
Define scope and success criteria, align owners across SRE, SWE, network, security, platform and data center teams, and drive decisions to closure
Review designs and technical proposals, challenge missing assumptions, and surface failure modes, dependencies and risks early
Track dependencies and risks across teams and time zones, and keep stakeholders, including the European teams, informed with clear, honest status
Drive adoption: make sure tools and workflows become the default way of working, with real documentation, runbooks and feedback loops
Establish and run lightweight, effective project management practices for the region: planning, prioritization, reviews, and post-launch follow-up
Work with regional teams and external partners (vendors, carriers) on the rollout of new network capabilities
Turn operational pain and engineering input into a clear, prioritized backlog
We expect you to have:
7+ years of experience in technical project management, engineering management or a hands-on engineering role (SRE, SWE, network or infrastructure), with a track record of delivering complex cross-team infrastructure projects
A real engineering background: you have built and operated production systems and can earn the trust of deeply technical teams
Ability to read design docs and technical proposals, understand trade-offs, and ask sharp questions about reliability, rollback, blast radius and failure modes
Strong understanding of infrastructure fundamentals (Linux, networking, automation, CI/CD) at the level needed to hold your own in technical discussions
Proven ability to drive decisions and create clarity in ambiguous, fast-changing environments without formal authority
Excellent written and verbal communication, including documenting plans and decisions and influencing smart technical people
Ability to work independently in an early-stage environment and to build processes from scratch
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) and comfort working across time zones
It will be an added bonus if you have:
Experience with network infrastructure: network automation, observability, or network device lifecycle management
Experience with SLO/SLI frameworks, incident management, or production readiness processes
Experience with CI/CD or change management for network or other high-blast-radius infrastructure
Benefits & Perks:
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's it like to work at
Nebius
:
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Nebius
is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Himalayas

Hands-on engineering contributions (scripts, tooling, automation) alongside project work

A user and secrets management system for network infrastructure, including robot-user lifecycle, safe key/password rotation, revocation, break-glass access, mixed agent/push-based device support, and integration with existing secrets backends

At ClearDATA, we provide secure, compliant cloud and managed services designed specifically for the healthcare industry. We are looking for a Senior Cloud Systems Engineer to join our Professional Services team and lead technical implementations across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
Job Summary:
We're looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to build security into how ClearDATA ships software. You'll work closely with our R&D organization to secure CI/CD pipelines, harden build and deployment processes, and make sure security is part of engineering's workflow rather than a gate at the end of it
Work Mode:
Remote
Shift Timings:
Monday to Friday – 5:30pm IST to 2:30am IST
Location:
Mumbai - Remote
Pipeline & Build Security
Partner with R&D to design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, from code commit through deployment.
Integrate static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), dependency and container scanning, and secrets management into the development lifecycle.
Harden build systems, artifact repositories, and deployment tooling against common attack paths.
Own infrastructure-as-code security: reviewing and improving how Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud configurations are written and deployed.
Partnership with R&D
Act as the security point of contact for engineering teams, helping them fix issues without slowing them down unnecessarily.
Review new tools, services, and architecture decisions for security implications before they ship.
Build automation and guardrails so secure practices are the path of least resistance for developers, not an extra step.
Cross-Team Collaboration
Work with the IT/ITSec Manager and Senior Compliance Analyst to make sure pipeline and infrastructure changes stay aligned with our compliance obligations.
Support incident response for anything touching build, deployment, or production infrastructure.
Help set and maintain security standards for software development lifecycle.undefined.
What We Are Looking For:
7-8 years in DevOps, platform engineering, or security engineering, with real hands-on pipeline and infrastructure experience.
Direct experience securing CI/CD pipelines and build systems, not just running them.
Strong background with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar).
Comfortable with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience with SAST/DAST tools, dependency scanning, and secrets management.
Able to work directly with engineers’ day to day and explain security tradeoffs in terms that land.
Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or GDPR is a plus, especially in healthcare or another regulated industry.
Good to have
Experience in a healthcare, fintech, or other regulated environment where security and compliance carry real weight.
Relevant certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP security specialties, CKS, or similar.

Role Summary
We are seeking a Manager of Multi-Touch Attribution to lead client engagements that measure how HCP and patient touchpoints, including field detailing, digital, paid media, email, congress, and medical education, contribute to prescription outcomes. You will own end-to-end attribution projects for pharma and biotech clients, from data integration and methodology design through stakeholder recommendations and budget reallocation guidance. You will also lead and develop a small team of consultants and analysts, and serve as a trusted advisor to brand, commercial operations, and marketing leaders.
Key Responsibilities
Lead client MTA engagements from scoping through delivery, setting timelines, budgets, and success criteria with client stakeholders.
Design attribution frameworks that combine rules-based, probabilistic, and algorithmic approaches (e.g., Markov chain, Shapley value, logistic or Bayesian models), and document their assumptions and limitations.
Should have understanding of MMx and Omnichannel analytics.
Integrate and reconcile multi-source data, including Rx and claims data, CRM and call activity, digital and email engagement logs, media delivery data, and sample or market access data, while maintaining patient and HCP privacy standards.
Triangulate MTA results with marketing mix modeling (MMM), geo-based or holdout incrementality tests, and other measurement methods to build a defensible, consistent view of channel performance.
Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for executive audiences, including channel ROI, sequencing insights, and reallocation scenarios.
Oversee code quality, model validation, and reproducibility across the team's analytical work.
Manage, coach, and develop consultants and analysts, including workload planning, performance feedback, and career development.
Contribute to firm thought leadership, proposal development, and the continued evolution of the firm's attribution methodology and accelerators.
Ensure all work complies with applicable regulations and internal standards, including the PhRMA Code, OPDP guidance, HIPAA, and regional privacy laws such as GDPR and CCPA.
Required Qualifications
6 or more years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, or data science, with at least 3 years in pharma, healthcare, or life sciences.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering multi-touch attribution or equivalent customer-journey analytics.
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R, with experience working in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.
Solid understanding of statistical modeling, causal inference, and experimental design, including the strengths and limitations of attribution compared to MMM and incrementality testing.
Working knowledge of pharma commercial data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, Veeva CRM) and pharma promotional channel structure.
Proven ability to present to senior client stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.
Experience leading or mentoring a team of at least 3 people in a client-service environment.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business discipline (statistics, economics, engineering, math, marketing analytics, or similar). An advanced degree is preferred.
requirements:

Familiarity with patient-journey analytics, omnichannel orchestration, or next-best-action frameworks.
Background in consulting, agency, or analytics vendor environments.

title: Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software
description:
Job Description
Purpose of the role
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
Accountabilities
Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.
Vice President Expectations
To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction.  They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
We are seeking an experienced Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software to join the Resilience Operations team, working alongside CTO Platform Engineering. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain cyber resilience and recovery tooling that enables teams across Barclays to autonomously manage protection and recovery operations. You'll work on a distributed microservices platform that orchestrates complex workflows across multi-infrastructure environments, integrates with enterprise governance systems, and handles real-time event streaming and state management. You will partner with infrastructure teams, security teams, and application owners to deliver solutions that reduce recovery times, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the bank's overall resilience posture. As a senior engineer, you'll own key architectural decisions, mentor team members, and contribute to evolving our platform's scalability, reliability, and security.
To be successful as a Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software , you should have experience in:
React or Angular front-end development (responsive, accessible UIs).
Go backend development, including REST API design and service integration.
GitLab CI/CD pipelines (build, test, scan, deploy automation).
Containerised applications on Kubernetes/OpenShift (deploy, run, troubleshoot).
Some other highly valued skills include:
TypeScript and modern front-end tooling and patterns.
API security and integration: OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, mTLS; data stores and messaging.
Helm and Infrastructure as Code, monitoring and logging.
Being a thought leader and innovator with experience in cloud and containerisation technologies.
Proven track record of delivering transformation at scale, moving legacy applications to cloud native micro-services architecture.
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, communication skills and interaction with a diverse range of stakeholders, as well as job-specific technical skills.
This role is based out of Pune.

description:
Overview
A Key Account Manager owns high-value restaurant partners within an assigned city, typically chains, established multi-outlet restaurants, and growing independents expanding to multiple locations. These accounts are more complex: they involve negotiations with multiple stakeholders, larger deal sizes, custom solutions, and deeper engagement around ROI and strategy. You combine field presence with office-based analysis and executive relationship management. Success requires both relationship skills and the analytical ability to build customized business cases. You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city-wide targets.

Own a portfolio of multi-outlet restaurants: Manage 30-40 high-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40-60% of city revenue

title: Vice President, Platform Engineering
description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Vice President, Platform Engineering
Role Overview
This is a senior site and technology leadership role. This role will provide visible leadership for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune and drive culture, growth, prioritisation and effectiveness of Vocalink Pune capability through influence and is accountable for the connection between Pune execution and UK leadership, architecture, engineering, programme and business priorities.
The successful candidate will bring enterprise-level technology leadership, executive presence and the ability to align a broad technical community via matrix management  authority. This is not a software engineering leadership role. It requires experience influencing multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture and enterprise technology stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities
• Act as the visible technology leadership and escalation point for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune, creating clarity and momentum without direct line-management authority.
• Drive Vocalink culture in Pune by leading  town halls, leadership forums and large colleague events, engaging and influencing audiences of 100 or more people.
• Maintain an effective UK–Pune operating link, influencing People Leaders and technical stakeholders to align local execution with UK strategy, architecture, governance and business accountability.
• Translate technology strategy, roadmaps and programme direction into a clear, sequenced and achievable portfolio of work.
• Facilitate and influence prioritisation across strategic change, regulatory commitments, operational resilience, technical debt and service improvement, securing agreement from accountable leaders.
• Provide matrix leadership across multidisciplinary teams, using technical fluency to challenge assumptions, expose dependencies and shape sound decisions.
• Establish governance for demand, capacity, delivery health, risks, dependencies and escalation.
• Identify and remove systemic blockers, including unclear ownership, decision delays, skills gaps, environmental constraints and cross-team dependencies.
• Influence UK and Pune leaders to grow the volume and complexity of work delivered from Pune by aligning demand, capacity, capability and realistic delivery plans.
• Drive measurable efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification, reuse and improved ways of working.
• Coach, connect and influence local leaders to drive talent retention, strengthen leadership depth, succession and technical capability while reinforcing an inclusive and accountable culture.
• Build effective relationships with senior leaders, architects, engineers, programme teams, support functions, partners and vendors.
Expected Outcomes
• A unified UK–Pune operating model achieved through strong relationships, shared priorities, clear ownership and effective escalation routes.
• A transparent and prioritised portfolio aligned to business outcomes and technology strategy.
• Pune Tech Hub strategy to create a high-performing, increasingly productive workforce, underpinned by robust quality, resilience and controls.
• Faster removal of blockers and more effective management of cross-functional dependencies.
• Measurable improvements in productivity, automation, deployment lead time and operational efficiency.
• A confident and increasingly self-sufficient Pune organisation, enabled through influence, coaching and stronger local leadership depth.
requirements:
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
• Significant senior leadership experience in a complex, multinational technology, payments or critical-infrastructure environment.
• Executive presence and gravitas, with evidence of commanding large audiences and remaining credible under challenge.
• Experience providing matrix leadership across multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture or enterprise technology teams. A career focused primarily on software engineering will not provide the breadth required.
• A track record of connecting offshore or remote technology capability with onshore leadership, strategy and accountability without relying on direct reporting lines.
• Strong programme and portfolio leadership covering direction-setting, prioritisation, sequencing, dependencies, risk and benefits delivery.
• Technical fluency across infrastructure, platforms, architecture, operations, resilience and security, with the ability to challenge technical positions without being the deepest subject-matter expert.
• Proven success in diagnosing delivery blockers, resolving ambiguity and establishing clear ownership and governance.
• Evidence of scaling workload and capability through effective demand, capacity and skills planning.
• Measurable delivery of efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification or operating-model change.
• Exceptional influencing, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with evidence of securing commitment and resolving conflict without formal authority.
• Commercial and financial discipline in managing resources, budgets and investment priorities.
• A people-centred leadership style that builds trust, accountability, inclusion and capability across cultures and locations through coaching, credibility and relationships.
• High personal integrity and a leadership approach aligned with Vocalink and Mastercard values.
What Success Looks Like
The successful leader will establish Pune as an integrated and trusted part of Mastercard (Vocalink) technology organisation through influence rather than hierarchy. They will convene stakeholders, create a sustainable pipeline of valuable work, resolve barriers and secure commitment to clear priorities, effective governance and measurable outcomes.
Essential Screening Summary
• Broad enterprise technology leadership, not solely software engineering.
• Proven executive presence and large-audience communication.
• Cross-location matrix leadership connecting Pune or offshore delivery with UK or onshore accountability.
• Programme direction, portfolio prioritisation and technical fluency.
• Evidence of influencing accountable leaders to remove blockers, scale workload and deliver measurable efficiencies.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job Description
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you: innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference.
Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to support our Accounts Payable operations and deliver accurate, timely, and high-quality financial services. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world.
It starts with YOU.
Main Purpose of the Role
Provide end-to-end support for the Accounts Payable and invoice processing process, ensuring timely and accurate processing of invoices and related transactions in SAP.
The role is responsible for maintaining accurate Accounts Payable records, supporting timely supplier payments, meeting agreed service levels, complying with internal controls, and providing quality service to internal and external customers.
Main / Primary Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
Receive, review, validate, process, and confirm invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and invoice provisions for purchases and expenses related to goods and services.
Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and contains the required approvals before processing transactions in SAP.
Register invoices, debit notes, and credit notes daily by performing the appropriate SAP transactions to maintain timely and accurate Accounts Payable records.
Meet agreed service levels for GBS Finance LAO customers, ensuring timely and quality delivery based on customer requirements.
Review Purchase Orders associated with invoices and validate goods receipts and service acceptances to ensure compliance with three-way matching / triple validation requirements.
Ensure supplier payment terms are correctly followed in accordance with company guidelines and support timely payment processing.
Review and release authorized pre-registered invoices for accounting and payment after validating the required information.
Provide documentation and information required by supported countries for audits, filing, analysis, and other Accounts Payable-related activities.
Respond to inquiries from internal and external customers and provide guidance relating to processes, systems, documentation, and Accounts Payable requirements.
Ensure activities are performed in accordance with applicable internal controls, data management requirements, and established procedures.
Comply with applicable safety, health, environmental, loss-control, and regulatory requirements.
Actively participate in and support continuous improvement and development initiatives promoted by the organization.
Ensure compliance with established quality requirements, with a focus on meeting the expectations of internal and external customers.
Support integration and implementation activities involving GBS services and customers.
Provide SAP and process support for implementation projects and new team members, including process training where required.
Participate in system updates and changes to SAP processes required by local or corporate markets.
Support the creation, review, and updating of process manuals and standard operating procedures.
Functional / Business Skills
To succeed in this role, you will need the ability to:
Maintain accurate records and controls for the company's Accounts Payable activities to support timely supplier payments.
Maintain reliable information within financial systems to support reporting and business decision-making.
Deliver quality and customer-focused service to supported markets and stakeholders.
Follow established systems, controls, procedures, and quality standards within the Accounts Payable function.
Use SAP Finance functionality to process and record transactions related to Accounts Payable.
Work with Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) or similar invoice management solutions for the receipt, control, and registration of supplier payment documents.
Apply knowledge of financial controls, accounting controls, performance metrics, financial systems, and continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes.
Identify, investigate, and resolve routine Accounts Payable issues in a timely manner.
Develop strong expertise in AP transaction processing and share process knowledge with colleagues when required.
Work accurately in a transaction-driven environment while meeting agreed timelines and service levels.
requirements:

You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with financial transactions and systems. You understand the importance of accuracy and timeliness when processing invoices and supporting supplier payments.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
A customer-focused mindset.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

English proficiency is desirable.

Customer-service orientation with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Specialist, Product Management - Data Analytics
Overview –
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, committed to driving innovation and advancing financial inclusion. Within Mastercard, Services provides advanced analytics, consulting, and digital solutions that help businesses, financial institutions, and governments make data-driven decisions.
Business & Market Insights (B&MI), a key part of Services, empowers organizations with differentiated data assets, analytics solutions, and advisory capabilities that enable confident decision-making and better business outcomes. Through partnerships with financial institutions, merchants, public sector organizations, and other stakeholders, B&MI delivers market intelligence, customer insights, and innovative solutions that accelerate growth.
The centralized Capabilities & Data (C&D) organization brings together foundational data, analytics, AI, data science, and platform engineering capabilities to accelerate B&MI's Vision. C&D provides the common data, analytical, and platform foundations that enable product teams to develop, scale, and enhance data-driven solutions more efficiently.
Role –
As part of Capabilities and Data (C&D) Team, you will support the development and enhancement of B&MI products by delivering analytical insights, data solutions, and operational support. Working closely with Product Management, Data Science, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams, you will help translate business requirements into actionable analytics, support product initiatives, and contribute to the development of scalable data capabilities that drive product innovation and client value.
-	Support the development and enhancement of product features by providing analytical insights aligned to client needs, business objectives, and market trends.
-	Analyze transaction, merchant, consumer, and market datasets to generate actionable insights that improve product capabilities and business outcomes.
-	Assist in addressing client queries and support product adoption through data-driven recommendations and analytical expertise.
-	Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting teams to execute product initiatives and deliver business value.
-	Develop and implement analytical models, statistical solutions, reporting frameworks, and dashboards to address business challenges and support decision-making.
-	Support the validation, optimization, deployment, and operationalization of analytical models and data-driven solutions.
-	Ensure the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and quality of data assets, analytical outputs, and product deliverables.
-	Monitor industry trends, emerging analytical techniques, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for product innovation and improvement.
-	Document analytical methodologies, processes, and best practices to support transparency, scalability, and knowledge sharing.
-	Independently execute assigned analytical projects and initiatives, contributing to continuous improvement and the growth of shared data and analytics capabilities across B&MI.
All about you –
•	Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in technology, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
•	Analytical Expertise: Proven ability to conduct data analysis to support product strategy, commercial decisions, and business growth.
•	Industry Knowledge: Experience in analytics solutions for payments, financial services, or related industries is preferred.
•	Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python, Hadoop, Excel, Tableau, and other analytics tools, with experience handling large datasets. Experience on AI tools is a plus.
•	Strategic Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset to break down complex and ambiguous problems into actionable insights.
•	Project Management: Ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize competing tasks, and drive end-to-end execution in a cross-functional environment.
•	Collaboration & Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to clearly articulate problem statements, insights, and opportunities to both internal and external partners.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Hitachi Energy
values.

title: Specialist, Engineering Services
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way
.
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
Assistant Project Manager- MEP
Project and Development Services – (Bangalore)
What this job involves:
Pillar of the team
Working closely with either the project manager or the senior project manager (or both), you’ll play a pivotal role in driving project success. You’ll take ownership of small projects, and provide a boost to the major ones. Being one of the leaders at the helm, you’ll explore ways to bring out the best in your team by striving to ensure optimal outcomes for all stakeholders. Likewise, you’ll play a lead role in managing the organizational structure for each project, making sure that all reporting, communication and working procedures are streamlined, and that every project has clear objectives in place.
Your attendance at project meetings is necessary, and you’ll be expected to create project-related reports, analyses and reviews.  Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail is crucial; this role needs someone who is good at forecasting project expenditure and ensuring effective management of project budgets.
Building strong client relationships
We live and breathe client satisfaction. We therefore need someone who shares the same passion and dedication. You’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying their needs, requirements and constraints.
Of course, as you represent our clients’ best interests, you’ll also keep in mind JLL’s own business needs—and, thereby, strive to achieve an ideal balance between the two. You’ll do so by being on the lookout for opportunities to introduce potential prospects to other business lines at JLL and build relationships with clients. You’ll also see to it that project revenue and payment cycles are properly managed to avoid bad debt.
Upholding excellence in project delivery
For over 200 years, JLL has become synonymous with project success—you will help continue this history of excellence. You’ll manage professional consultants necessary for the design and documentation of the project, as well as carry out contract administration of all vendors professionally and in accordance with legal requirements to protect commercial interests of clients and JLL. You will also help identify project risks and implement measures to mitigate them. Similarly, core to our reputation is our strong focus on health & safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front-of-mind at all times.
Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines.
Sound like you?
Our successful Project Managers …
Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
To apply you need to be:
An expert in the field
We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a degree in any property-related discipline, and at least three years of experience in design, construction or project management.
Our project management teams are tech-savvy and digitally enabled. We are the digital leader in project management, so it’s important that you help drive the effective use of JLL technology platforms to deliver our projects.
An empowering colleague
In this role, you’ll work with people of different ranks and responsibilities—that is why the ideal candidate is expected to promote open and constructive relationships with superiors, subordinates, peers and clients. With a healthy drive to succeed, you’ll achieve your goals most effectively when you work together and collaborate.
What we can do for you:
At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
Apply today!

48
