title: Program Manager - Global Expansion
description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.
Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
Role Overview
Job Title:
Manager - Program Management, International Expansion (Indonesia and Europe)
Location:
Noida
About the Role
As a Manager – Program Management for International Expansion, you will play a pivotal role in driving Paytm’s global footprint and international expansion initiatives. You will act as the single point of ownership for coordinating complex, multi-country rollouts, aligning internal technology, product, legal, compliance, and business teams with external partners and regulatory stakeholders.
In this high-visibility role, you will be responsible for orchestrating end-to-end product and tech program delivery across international markets (such as Indonesia and Europe/Luxembourg), ensuring roadmap execution, and issue resolution across cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities
International Program Governance:
Lead end-to-end programme management for international launches (e.g., Luxembourg and European expansion), defining milestones, governance frameworks, and driving operational readiness across internal and external stakeholders.
Product & Tech Coordination:
Oversee roadmap planning and development delivery for international markets (e.g., Indonesia), aligning engineering, product, and business goals to deliver robust market-specific solutions.
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Orchestration:
Bring together internal engineering, product, legal, finance, risk, and compliance teams alongside external banking, regulatory, and corporate partners to streamline expansion workflows.
Day-to-Day Issue Resolution:
Act as the primary escalation point to troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, technical dependencies, and cross-team friction points, ensuring rapid, smooth execution.
Progress Tracking & Risk Management:
Establish transparent program tracking frameworks, proactively identify cross-border operational or technical risks, and present actionable mitigation plans to senior leadership.
requirements:
Experience Required:
6–9 years
Functional Area:
Technology / Enabling Functions – Technical Program Management
Qualifications & Skills
Required Qualifications
Experience:
6 to 9 years of strong experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management (TPM), or Product Operations within Fintech, Digital Payments, E-commerce, or fast-growing Global Tech platforms.
Program Management Expertise:
Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, international programs from inception to commercial go-live.
Cross-Functional & External Coordination:
Demonstrated ability to align internal technology/product units with external partners, banking, vendor, or regulatory partners across different geographies.
Technical & Product Acumen:
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), product roadmapping, API integrations, and digital payment ecosystems.
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with cross-border payments, market launches, or international entity/corporate setup in regions across SEA or Europe.
PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile Scrum Master certification (a plus, not required).
Familiarity with international regulatory, data privacy, and compliance landscapes in digital financial services.
AI Expectations
At Paytm, we cultivate an AI-first culture to accelerate execution speed and operational efficiency. In this role, you are expected to:
Utilize AI-driven productivity tools for automated documentation, meeting summaries, and multi-market status aggregation.
Implement AI tools for risk analysis, timeline forecasting, and dependency tracking across complex multi-team roadmaps.
Continuously experiment with AI capabilities to optimize workflow automation, communication channels, and program reporting.
Ideal Candidate Profile
End-to-End Ownership:
Displays deep accountability for driving international projects across the finish line despite regional complexities.
Bias for Action & Speed:
Operates with high urgency to remove execution blockers and coordinate cross-functional alignment rapidly.
Adaptability & Ambiguity:
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments with evolving priorities and distributed cross-cultural teams.
Collaborative Communication:
Excellent articulation and stakeholder management skills to negotiate timelines, align goals, and foster strong partnerships.
Career Stability:
Demonstrates consistent career progression, sustained program delivery, and meaningful tenure in previous organizations.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Orchestration: Bring together internal engineering, product, legal, finance, risk, and compliance teams alongside external banking, regulatory, and corporate partners to streamline expansion workflows.
Day-to-Day Issue Resolution: Act as the primary escalation point to troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, technical dependencies, and cross-team friction points, ensuring rapid, smooth execution.
Progress Tracking & Risk Management: Establish transparent program tracking frameworks, proactively identify cross-border operational or technical risks, and present actionable mitigation plans to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications
Experience: 6 to 9 years of strong experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management (TPM), or Product Operations within Fintech, Digital Payments, E-commerce, or fast-growing Global Tech platforms.
Program Management Expertise: Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, international programs from inception to commercial go-live.
Cross-Functional & External Coordination: Demonstrated ability to align internal technology/product units with external partners, banking, vendor, or regulatory partners across different geographies.
Technical & Product Acumen: Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), product roadmapping, API integrations, and digital payment ecosystems.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

Hands-on experience with cross-border payments, market launches, or international entity/corporate setup in regions across SEA or Europe.
PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile Scrum Master certification (a plus, not required).
Familiarity with international regulatory, data privacy, and compliance landscapes in digital financial services.

At Paytm, we cultivate an AI-first culture to accelerate execution speed and operational efficiency. In this role, you are expected to:
Utilize AI-driven productivity tools for automated documentation, meeting summaries, and multi-market status aggregation.
Implement AI tools for risk analysis, timeline forecasting, and dependency tracking across complex multi-team roadmaps.
Continuously experiment with AI capabilities to optimize workflow automation, communication channels, and program reporting.

End-to-End Ownership: Displays deep accountability for driving international projects across the finish line despite regional complexities.
Bias for Action & Speed: Operates with high urgency to remove execution blockers and coordinate cross-functional alignment rapidly.
Adaptability & Ambiguity: Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments with evolving priorities and distributed cross-cultural teams.
Collaborative Communication: Excellent articulation and stakeholder management skills to negotiate timelines, align goals, and foster strong partnerships.
Career Stability: Demonstrates consistent career progression, sustained program delivery, and meaningful tenure in previous organizations.

title: Business Operations - General Manager - CST Travel
description:
About Us:
Paytm
is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy using technology.
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly accomplished, execution-focused
General Manager — Travel Business Operations
to lead end-to-end service operations, team performance, vendor ecosystems, and process delivery across
Paytm’s Travel vertical (Flights, Bus, Hotels).
In this leadership role, you will be directly responsible for driving operational excellence, enforcing strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs), managing large-scale internal and outsourced operations teams, and optimizing cost structures across business operations. You will act as the operational anchor connecting frontline execution directly with executive leadership.
Key Responsibilities
1. Core Service Operations & SLA Governance
End-to-End Operational Execution: Direct day-to-day business operations across Travel verticals (Flights, Bus, Hotels), ensuring seamless execution, high customer satisfaction, and service continuity.
SLA & Performance Management: Set, monitor, and enforce strict operational KPIs and service delivery SLAs (TAT, FCR, Quality Scores, CSAT/NPS) across all customer touchpoints.
Cost & Budget Optimization: Evaluate operational budgets, control unit operational costs, and identify cost-efficiency initiatives to maximize operational ROI in line with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
2. Large Team Leadership & Capacity Planning
People Management: Lead, mentor, and build high-performing operational leaders (Managers, Team Leads, and Operations Executives), fostering a culture of accountability and continuous performance improvement.
Resource & Capacity Planning: Direct workforce planning, shift alignment, and seasonal ramping to handle volume spikes and ensure smooth operational throughput during peak travel periods.
Performance Reviews & Governance: Conduct regular operational performance reviews, establish clear individual and team deliverables, and manage performance benchmarks across all operational tiers.
3. Vendor Management & Partner Governance
Outsourced Partner Governance: Oversee third-party vendor operations, partner call centers, and BPO relationships to ensure strict alignment with Paytm’s operational guidelines and quality standards.
Vendor Contract & Billing Audits: Manage partner SLAs, audit vendor billing against delivery metrics, and drive continuous improvement programs across vendor partners.
4. Process Excellence, Escalation Management & Risk Control
Process Optimization: Audit existing operational workflows, identify operational bottlenecks, and streamline process steps to eliminate service delays and reduce manual re-work.
Customer Escalations & Crisis Management: Handle critical, high-severity operational escalations, establishing clear root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action plans to prevent recurrence.
Risk & Quality Assurance: Establish robust maker-checker controls, quality audit frameworks, and compliance checks across all operational transactions.
Candidate Qualifications & Requirements
Education:
Graduate/Post-Graduate degree in Operations Management, Business Administration (MBA preferred), or related fields.
Experience: 10–14+ years of overall experience leading large-scale Customer Operations,
Service Delivery, or Business Operations within fast-paced E-commerce, BPO/KPO, or Travel sectors (Travel industry experience highly preferred).
Leadership & Team Size:
Proven track record of directly and indirectly managing large, multi-tiered operations teams (100+ span of control) and vendor networks.
Operational Execution:
Deep expertise in vendor management, SLA enforcement, workforce forecasting, and operational turnaround management.
Stakeholder Management:
Outstanding communication and leadership skills, with demonstrated experience delivering operational reviews and strategic updates to C-suite and executive stakeholders.
Why Join Us:
2.  Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3.  A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4.  Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Hands-on exposure to Tech Talent Acquisition and recruitment operations.
Experience working on real-time technology hiring requirements.
Exposure to sourcing, screening, HR calls and interview coordination.
Experience handling tech hiring drives and recruitment reporting.
Opportunity to interact with candidates, recruiters and business stakeholders.

Job Description:
The Opportunity
You as a Contract Manager, will be part of Power Grids, Grid Integration (PGGI) business based in Hitachi Energy (HE)Office, Gurgaon, India. With analytical, hands-on and autonomous approach, you contribute to the successful performance of contract through your Contract Management skill in the assigned project. You shall be a reliable partner, when it comes to the day-to-day contract administration and project execution, flow-down and preparation of subcontracts/purchase orders. You will be required to ensure that contract management, change management and risk management activities are timely and accurately executed protecting HE’s interests throughout project(s) lifecycle.
How you’ll make an impact
Ensuring that own assigned portfolio of contracts or specific project(s) (back-office or at the site) follow contract and claim management methodologies in accordance with applicable procedures.
Provides guidance and leadership on contract related matters to cross-functional project team members.
Developing contract management strategy based on HE’s policies, customer requirements, and the overall execution strategy considering risk, pricing, scope, and schedule.
Identifying the contract baseline (including terms and conditions, specifications, drawings, estimate, proposal, schedule and other documents incorporated in the contract) and highlighting areas of opportunities and potential risk.
Ensuring timely and accurate execution of commercial aspects in portfolio of contracts / subcontracts (e.g., payments, claims, variation orders, warranties, provisions, guarantees, etc.).
Verifying that all parties to the contract have fulfilled their contractual obligations and there are no responsibilities outstanding.
Assessing the success of the contract and determines if there are any lessons learned for future contracting.
Documenting and communicating to all relevant parties any deficiencies found as part of the closeout process.
Establishing and enforcing standard methodologies in portfolio of contracts to identify, notify, enforce or defend changes / claims (passive/active) coming from / towards third parties.
In concert with HE Legal, develops the negotiation strategy and supports negotiations. Supports HE Legal in handling dispute resolution, litigation and arbitration proceedings. Notifies and liaises with HE Legal to report major claims and keeps HE Legal updated on any critical development during project execution.
Supporting in drafting of contracts, subcontracts and supply contracts and ensuring that relevant (supply / sub) contracts contain appropriate contract terms to protect HE's interest including flow-down of main contract terms.
Analyzing contract terms to highlight areas of potential opportunity and risk.
Seeking advice from HE Legal to draft, negotiating and finalizing agreements during the Project execution phases.
Developing and implementing risk mitigation and opportunity plans in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
Ensures insurance provisions within the contract are adhered to and coordinates with Insurance Risk Management regarding occurrences that may be covered by customer / third party or HE provided insurance. Supporting Insurance Risk Management in producing damage reports.
Seeking advice from HE Legal/Export Control to ensure accurate handling of all export control matters regarding restrictions on exports, applicable destination laws considering countries, customers or products involved and the respective laws and HE regulations.
Ensuring that the information and data are protected as per HE’s policies and relevant NDA/confidentiality agreements are in place while sharing of information with other parties.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, Economics or Law.
Working knowledge and hands-on experience on contracts executed under common law/Indian law.
Preferably 10 years or more hands-on experience in EPC projects within the fields of power generation, substations, converter stations, grid integration, transmission or similar industrial plant within a Contract Management and Subcontract Management functions (with emphasis on civil and electrical installations interfaces).
Demonstrating successful experience in processing, managing and administrating varying sizes, types and complexity of contractual agreements during the execution and closing stages of projects lifecycle.
Previous experience in the Indian power transmission/grid projects is highly desirable.
Solid experience in project’s change management, claim management and contract-related legal issues and the possible effects in the relevant areas of responsibility regarding proposal stage and/or project execution.
Ability to interface and negotiate with customers and subcontractors regarding all matters related to contracts and projects including those related to the review and process of changes.
Ability to work in a corporate office and/or project site environment
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.
Accessibility and reasonable accommodation
Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a
general inquiry form
on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.
This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.
Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment
As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as
Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.
Background Screening and Security Checks
As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.
For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.
The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

title: Senior Manager/Manager - Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Governance
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Overview
The Senior Manager/Manager – TPRM Governance will lead the strategic design, operationalization, and ongoing oversight of the enterprise-wide Third-Party Risk Management framework.
This role is responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating third-party risks across all vendors, suppliers, and partners.
The person will champion the TPRM framework as aligned to applicable compliances across regulations and statutory mandates—while serving as the primary bridge between cross-functional business units, executive leadership, internal and external stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
TPRM Framework & Policy Governance
Establish robust governance mechanisms and the end-to-end design for formulating, executing, and enhancing TPRM control frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures.
Ensure enterprise-wide adoption of third-party risk methodologies, aligning with applicable regulatory requirements.
Drive a data-driven risk-based approach to 3rd party evaluation, exception identification, and reporting.
Design, consolidate, and present executive TPRM dashboards, trend analyses, and exception reports directly to the Risk Management Committee, Board of Directors, and Senior leadership.
Third-Party Risk Assessment
Perform inherent and residual risk assessments, monitor SLA adherence, performance metrics, and control effectiveness across the vendor lifecycle.
Lead and oversee continuous vendor risk evaluations across multiple domains, including financial health, information security, operational resilience, legal, compliance, and reputational risk.
Maintain and govern a centralized, risk-tiered vendor inventory categorizing third parties based on service nature, data access, regulatory criticality, and concentration risk.
Define periodic due diligence and monitoring frequencies aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory standards.
Lead the ongoing monitoring strategy for critical third parties, utilizing SLA performance tracking, continuous financial health reviews, threat intelligence feeds, and regulatory sanction screening.
Manage and orchestrate structured, periodic vendor risk questionnaire assessments and remediation programs as defined under the TPRM framework.
Track vendor incidents, operational control failures, and risk events to drive remediation, while maintaining up-to-date policies, SOPs, risk registers, and governance reporting.
Required Skills & Competencies:-
Industry Expertise: 6+ years of domain experience in Third-Party Risk Management, including Outsourcing Risk, Vendor Evaluation, Operational Risk, or Risk Governance within BFSI, FinTech, or a regulated environment.
Regulatory Frameworks: Deep understanding of regulatory guidelines on Third-Party Governance standards.
Vendor & Operational Oversight: Demonstrated expertise in 3rd Party due diligence, SLA governance, regulatory compliances, and audit support for key third parties
Multi-Domain Risk Evaluation: Proven capability to assess complex, multi-domain vendor risk scenarios across legal, financial, cyber, operational, and regulatory vectors.
Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Strong expertise in risk scoring models, trend analysis, exception tracking, and executive dashboarding.
requirements:
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Commerce, Law, Information Security, or a related discipline.
Certifications: Professional certifications in Risk Management or Information Security (e.g., ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CERA) are preferred.

title: HRBP & Talent Acquisition
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a dynamic, agile, and tech-savvy
Senior Executive – HRBP & TA
to drive end-to-end talent acquisition and business partnering for key teams across ixigo. In this hybrid role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, talent partner to line managers, and candidate advocate—managing everything from hiring top-tier talent (especially in tech, product, and business roles) to enabling a high-performance, empathetic work culture.
If you are passionate about leveraging AI and data in HR, executing seamless employee lifecycles, and scaling talent in a high-growth, listed travel-tech business, we’d love to connect!
What You’ll Do
1. Talent Acquisition & Sourcing (50%)
End-to-End Recruitment:
Own full-cycle recruitment for designated business units—sourcing, screening, interviewing, negotiating offers, and facilitating onboarding.
AI & Modern Sourcing:
Leverage AI tools (LLM-based sourcing, automated resume screening, and smart candidate matching) to build strong talent pipelines and reduce time-to-hire.
Stakeholder Management:
Partner closely with hiring managers and team leads to map talent requirements, craft job descriptions, and set clear expectations on timelines.
Employer Branding & Experience:
Ensure a smooth, engaging, and professional experience for candidates at every stage of the hiring journey.
2. HR Business Partnering (HRBP) (40%)
Employee Lifecycle Management:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle—onboarding, probation tracking, continuous performance checks, continuous engagement, and offboarding/exit interviews.
Business Partnership:
Partner with line managers to understand team dynamics, address talent needs, and support org design and workforce planning.
Culture & Engagement:
Actively drive pulse checks, skip-level interactions, and continuous feedback loops to maintain high employee morale and engagement.
Performance & Retention:
Assist in performance management cycles, help line managers address performance gaps, and execute retention strategies to reduce attrition.
3. HR Operations, AI & Analytics (10%)
HR Data & Insights:
Use HR data to track key metrics like attrition risk, recruitment SLAs, hiring quality, and candidate drop-offs.
HRIS & Compliance:
Maintain accurate employee data on the HRIS platform and ensure compliance with internal guidelines and labor regulations.
Process Enablement:
Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR workflows using modern tools and AI.
Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

of hands-on experience in Talent Acquisition and/or HRBP roles within high-growth tech, e-commerce, or consumer internet companies.

Proven track record of hiring across diverse technical and non-technical functions with strong headhunting and talent-mapping abilities.
Tech & AI Literacy:
Hands-on exposure to modern HRIS systems, ATS tools, and AI-enabled sourcing/screening tools.
Business Acumen:
Ability to understand business goals and translate them into actionable talent strategies.
Data-Driven Approach:
Comfort working with HR metrics, analytics, and basic data visualization to draw actionable insights.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with a strong bias for action and empathy.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary
As the Application Specialist for Ultrasound, you will be responsible for driving and executing clinical education training, demonstration management, and demonstration strategies. You will facilitate evidence-based practices and support both the customer experience and commercial teams from pre-sale through post-implementation by delivering effective, outcome-based education and training solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.
Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the region; responsible for training the sales and dealer teams periodically to enhance their capabilities.
Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.
Promote new product features (NPI) and clinical techniques; collaborate with customers to develop training plans and strategies that support new product adoption and ongoing training needs in Ultrasound.
Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.
The incumbent will be based as per requirement and will support the LCT (Local Customer Team) or the Region depending on the scope of priority.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 5+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential
Ultrasound technical/clinical industry experience is required, along with any applicable certifications.
Good knowledge of 2D, Doppler, and color flow imaging, with experience in 3D and 4D imaging (especially for OB/GYN).
Must be willing to travel up to 75%, both within and outside the assigned geographic region.
Desired Characteristics
Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs
Inclusion and Diversity
GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.
This team’s first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:
Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure
Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible
Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Who We Are
GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.
Responsibilities
Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security
Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one
Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders
Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem
Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership
Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward
Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing global team by setting clear goals and operating rhythms; coaching and developing talent through regular, candid feedback and career conversations; monitoring team health and engagement; recognizing strong performance and addressing performance concerns early and fairly; and communicating change early with clarity and context

The Community You Will Join
:
No global movement springs from individuals. It takes an entire team united behind something big. On the Delivery team at Airbnb, we're proud to be at the forefront of the sharing economy. We recognize that we are the leaders of a new, worldwide phenomenon, and that's why we're working so hard to build the world's most loyal travel community.
Together, our team provides support to more than 100 million lifetime guests and 3 million listings in over 191 countries. Our India Global operations hub delivers several of Community Support's most sensitive and complex specialty services, working as one team with our global process leads. The Difference You Will Make
:
As a Senior Manager, Safety you will own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of Global Operation's most sensitive and highest-severity specialty services, spanning close to 200 team members across Specialists, Team Specialists, Supervisors and Managers. You will be accountable for KPIs, people and the overall health of the business, with direct exposure to user-safety, regulatory and financial-loss risk and the authority to make final calls on complex, irreversible decisions.
You will act as senior delivery partner to the global process leads for your services — translating global agendas into on-the-ground execution and giving those leads a single accountable counterpart at site. You will be expected to build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders while constantly looking for opportunities to streamline and optimize our operations. As our portfolio evolves, you should expect the mix of services in scope to change, and be comfortable picking up new skills and queues as the business requires.

Manage the day-to-day operations of the services in scope, driving the highest level of performance from the teams and establishing the right performance management and coaching structure and cadence in collaboration with Delivery leaders and Quality teams
Define, monitor, report and improve efficiency and quality metrics for each service based on its performance scorecard, keeping Global operations in India aligned to global standards while accounting for local nuance
Adapt and pre-empt adaptations of the performance management structure based on shifting business priorities, volume patterns and peak planning
Bring a data-driven lens to occupancy, SLA, capacity and workforce decisions, and make timely calls when the numbers move
Lead and grow a multi-layered leadership team:
Lead a mixed layer of leadership — a Manager alongside Supervisors reporting in directly — which means being comfortable leading junior leadership hands-on rather than only through a manager layer
Coach Supervisors on daily performance management as readily as you set quarterly direction, and stay close enough to the floor to spot execution gaps early
Support Managers and Supervisors to ensure high employee engagement and delivery of a world class experience for both our community and our internal stakeholders
Oversee team structure, recruitment, onboarding, training and upskilling plans, and build a credible succession and cross-skilling pipeline across the portfolio
Be a focused, visible leader who creates supportive connections across the whole team through open communication, and who carries teams through change and periods of instability
Partner with global process leads and eliminate functional silos:
Stay ahead of global Ops priorities and make sure ACC delivery is set up to execute them — owning the on-the-ground landing of global programmes to timeline and quality
Surface operational pain points early enough to influence global design rather than after the fact, and carry ACC best practice back into the global forums
Work across services and with Quality, Training, Business Process Improvement, Analytics and WFM to eliminate functional and working silos, so process changes land consistently rather than function by function
Feed insights into process, policy and tooling improvements, and drive relationships and coordinate requests with shared services teams
Support the global consolidation agenda where ACC is scaling towards becoming the primary or sole servicing site for a skill, ensuring transitions land without disruption to the community
Manage senior and executive stakeholders:
Be responsible and accountable for executive and senior leadership stakeholder management, adapting your communication to the audience and remaining flexible and available to our leaders
Have a deep understanding and expertise of our operations, workflows, policies and systems, so you can assess cases yourself and make the right call on what needs to be done to solve our users' issues
Represent ACC credibly in global forums, holding policy, quality and risk conversations independently
Work with the long term in mind to reduce the volume and severity of complex cases:
Track and understand the common themes behind complex cases and escalations, close the loop, and set up the right forums to solve root causes with cross-functional teams across Global Ops
Partner with cross-functional Airbnb teams to champion improvements to our process, policies and product that improve the customer experience and reduce community escalations

Strong end-to-end frontline operations management experience in a customer-facing environment, with a track record of owning KPIs, people and business health for a large team; overall experience of minimum 13 years.
Highly agile — able to pick up new skills, services and queues quickly, and to re-prioritize as the portfolio and global agenda shift
Advanced people leadership, performance management, coaching and mentoring experience, including leading through both a manager layer and direct supervisor relationships

About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role:
We are looking for a strategic, data-driven Growth leader to drive UPI GMV and transaction growth across the Paytm ecosystem. The role will focus on increasing merchant transaction volumes, improving share of wallet, retaining high-value merchants and reducing churn through targeted, cohort-led growth strategies. The ideal candidate will combine strong growth and analytical thinking with expertise in experimentation, segmentation and lifecycle management to drive sustainable business outcomes at scale.
Key Responsibilities:
- UPI Growth:
Own and drive UPI GMV and transaction growth, improving merchant engagement, transaction frequency and overall business performance.
- High Value Merchant Retention:
Identify and address declining activity among high-value merchants, focusing on retention, reactivation and reducing churn.
- Share of Wallet and Market Share:
Develop strategies to increase Paytm’s share of merchant transactions and strengthen market position.
- Cohort led Growth:
Build targeted growth strategies using merchant segmentation, Pareto-based analysis and cohort performance to improve engagement and retention.
- Growth Analytics and Experimentation:
Track key KPIs, analyze funnels and behavioral trends, and drive hypothesis-led experiments and A/B testing to improve business outcomes.
- Lifecycle Management:
Design targeted engagement, retention and win back initiatives, including active-to-soft-churn interventions.
- Cross Functional Collaboration:
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and Business teams to identify growth opportunities and execute scalable initiatives.
- Team Leadership:
Lead growth charters, mentor team members and foster a culture of ownership, analytical thinking and execution excellence.
Why join us
:  We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants, and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role:
- We are looking for a strategic, data-driven Growth leader to drive business growth across
Card payments and Pay By Link (PBL)
within the Paytm for Business ecosystem.
- The role will own key growth metrics, including Card GMV and transactions and PBL GMV and Monthly Active Users (MAUs).
- The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving merchant acquisition and activation, increasing product adoption and usage, strengthening retention among high-value cohorts, and expanding market share across these businesses.
- This is a high-ownership role requiring strong growth strategy, analytical capabilities, experimentation and execution.
- The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Risk and Business teams to build scalable growth initiatives and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Card Business Growth:
-
Own and drive Card GMV and transaction growth through targeted acquisition, activation and engagement strategies.
- Increase card acceptance and adoption among merchants and drive deeper usage among existing card-transacting merchants.
- Improve the percentage of active card-transacting merchants and strengthen card penetration and market share.
- Identify opportunities to increase transaction frequency, average transaction value and overall merchant contribution.
- Develop strategies to retain and grow high-value card merchant cohorts, with a focus on the 80/20 principle and Pareto-based cohort management
.
2. Personal Business Loans (PBL) Growth:
- Drive PBL GMV and growth in Monthly Active Users (MAUs) across EDC and non-EDC merchant segments.
- Develop  growth strategies to improve product discovery, eligibility-led engagement, application conversion and successful loan disbursals.
- Identify opportunities to expand product adoption and engagement across existing and new merchant cohorts.
- Work with Product, Risk, Data and Business teams to optimize acquisition funnels and improve conversion across the customer journey.
3. Growth Analytics, Retention and Experimentation:
- Define, own and track business KPIs across Card and PBL, including GMV, transactions, adoption, active users, retention and market share.
- Use  funnel analysis, cohort analysis, merchant segmentation and behavioral insights to identify growth opportunities.
- Design and execute experiments, A/B tests and targeted growth interventions to improve conversion, engagement and retention.
- Build strategies to protect high-value cohorts, reactivate dormant users and increase the lifetime value of existing customers.
- Establish scalable growth playbooks and lifecycle marketing initiatives across different merchant and customer segments.
4. Cross-functional Leadership and Executions:
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Risk and Business teams to execute growth initiatives.
- Translate business priorities and analytical insights into actionable growth roadmaps with clear success metrics.
- Lead and mentor teams, fostering strong ownership, structured problem-solving and execution excellence.
- Continuously identify new growth opportunities across the Card and PBL businesses to drive sustainable and profitable growth.
Why Join Us?
At Paytm, you will have the opportunity to build and scale growth initiatives across a large merchant and financial services ecosystem. With a broad customer base, millions of merchants and rich behavioral data, you can drive meaningful business impact while helping bring more Indians into the mainstream economy through technology.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Your Impact:
As a Marketing Manager for India, you will lead the development and execution of joint marketing strategies and programs with Cisco’s channel partners. Your role will focus on driving partner engagement, demand generation, and co-marketing initiatives that accelerate pipeline growth and revenue. You will collaborate closely with sales, partner teams, and global marketing to align partner marketing efforts with Cisco’s business priorities.
Responsibilities:
Partner Strategy & Joint Planning:
Build annual and quarterly co-marketing plans with tier-1 channel partners to drive shared pipeline and revenue goals.
Demand Generation Campaigns:
Design, launch, and optimize through-channel marketing automation campaigns, digital programs, and localized events.
Enablement & Collateral:
Create high-impact partner toolkits, co-branded collateral, email templates, and product launch playbooks.
Partner Portal Management:
Oversee and optimize the company’s partner portal as a central hub for marketing resources, DGI (Demand Gen Incentive) requests, and asset distribution.
Budget & MDF Administration:
Manage and track co-op and Market Development Funds (MDF), ensuring efficient allocation and high ROI on partner investments.
Performance Analytics:
Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) including partner-sourced pipeline, program engagement, conversion rates, and ROI.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Align closely with Channel Sales / Partner Account Managers (PAMs), product marketing, and field marketing teams.
requirements:
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with at least 8 years focused on channel marketing, partner ecosystems, or alliances.
Strong familiarity with B2B technology ecosystems, including SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise IT solutions.
Proficient in CRM systems such as Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.
Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with proven ability to manage external partner relationships and align cross-functional teams.
Skilled in project management to drive marketing initiatives and meet business goals.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
Disclaimer
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
begin with screening or an interview
originate from a Cisco email address, and
be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx
Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than
https://careers.cisco.com
or
cisco.wd5.myworkday.com
, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Cluster Head- Last Mile
description:
About the Team
Being part of Meesho's Fulfilment and Experience (F&E) team as Cluster Head LM,
will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship, where you get to
directly shape the experience of the country's next billion e-commerce users.
We are an eclectic mix of 100+ professionals with diverse skill sets ranging from
running operations/support, supply chain know-how, analytics and the holy grail,
first principles problem-solving. At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been
done before - taking e-commerce to the masses. This leaves us with no choice but to
completely reimagine logistics from the ground up, to cater to our customers' price
and delivery expectations. That means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers,
anyone?) to build a supply chain to change how folks think about e-commerce
in India and globally. We are firm believers in fun at work. With monthly F&E happy
hour sessions, informal team outings, and internal virtual water cooler chat sessions,
there’s never a dull moment with us
About the Role
As Cluster Head LM, you’ll own the onboarding and training of partners. You’ll also
drive key operational metrics by regularly visiting their facilities in different cities in
your area. You’ll take complete ownership of processes allotted to you and work
with various stakeholders to achieve team goals. You’ll continuously work towards
identifying gaps and providing recommendations for improving our processes.
What you will do
Own the onboarding and training of new partners for Last Mile operations in your cluster.
Identify and onboard new partners onto the network on an ongoing basis
Track and own the performance of different partners in your cluster
Visit facilities to conduct audits and solve operational gaps
Ensure compliance with operational processes
Own and drive critical operational metrics end to end and achieve performance
targets
Continuously work towards identifying gaps and provide recommendations for
improving our processes
What you will need
Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any discipline
3-5 years of work experience in the e-commerce logistics domain
Experience in partner onboarding and training in the Last Mile and sorting operations
About us
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
, we uphold the following principles:
Equal Opportunity
: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
Accessible Workplace
: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
Inclusive Hiring Process
: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
Career Growth
: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
Support & Confidentiality
: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
Awareness & Inclusion
: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.
Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.
Know more about Meesho here :
https://www.meesho.io/

title: HR- Talent Acquisition
description:
Job Description: Talent Acquisition – Leadership Hiring
Company:
Paytm
Location:
Noida
About the Role
Paytm is looking for a sharp, proactive Talent Acquisition professional to drive senior and leadership hiring. This role goes beyond filling positions. You'll find and bring in exceptional leaders who drive transformation, innovation, and business growth. You'll work closely with business heads and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor.
Key Responsibilities
- Drive end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership roles, from understanding the requirement through offer and onboarding.
- Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand strategic hiring needs and define success profiles for each role.
- Lead talent mapping, market intelligence, and competitor talent research to build strong leadership pipelines.
- Find and engage high-caliber professionals through LinkedIn, headhunting, referrals, networking, and other sourcing channels.
- Run structured interview and assessment processes for leadership candidates.
- Manage senior stakeholder relationships and give candidates a confidential, high-quality experience.
- Handle compensation discussions, offer negotiations, and closures for critical mandates.
- Track hiring metrics such as time-to-hire, offer acceptance, and pipeline health, and share insights with stakeholders.
- Deliver high-quality hiring outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Why Join Us
- Work directly with Paytm's senior leadership on strategic hiring.
- Help shape leadership teams at one of India's leading fintech companies.
- A fast-paced culture built on ownership.
requirements:
Experience:
4–6 years
Requirements
- 4–6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with exposure to leadership or executive hiring.
- Strong headhunting, sourcing, talent mapping, and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
- Proven ability to engage senior professionals and close critical hiring mandates.
- Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter and applicant tracking systems.
Preferred Background
Experience with executive search or leadership hiring firms, AI-led companies, or IT services and technology recruitment.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About the Role:
As a Senior Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.
You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.
Responsibilities:
Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions
Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

requirements:

User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs

Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns

AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

● Coordinate with schools and local stakeholders for permissions and scheduling of

students and school staff.

Job Description
Job Purpose
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific's Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by identifying, developing, and expanding commercial opportunities across biopharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, CDMOs, academic research institutes, hospitals, and emerging Cell & Gene Therapy organizations. Collaborate with internal business units to deliver integrated workflow solutions that accelerate customers' research, process development, clinical translation, and manufacturing of advanced therapies.

•	Drive business growth for the Cell & Gene Therapy portfolio across assigned territories and customer segments.

•	Promote Thermo Fisher's comprehensive CGT portfolio, including cell culture media, reagents, viral vectors, plasmids, bioprocessing solutions, analytical instruments, consumables, and services. 
•	Collaborate with Business Unit Specialists, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, and Service teams to deliver integrated One Thermo Fisher solutions. 
•	Generate and manage a healthy sales pipeline while achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets. 
•	Develop account plans for strategic customers and execute activities to increase share of wallet. 
•	Conduct scientific discussions, product demonstrations, customer presentations, workshops, and seminars to increase market awareness. 
•	Monitor customer pipelines, funding activities, clinical programs, and manufacturing expansion plans to identify future business opportunities. 
•	Gather market intelligence on competitors, customer needs, emerging technologies, and industry trends to support business strategy. 
•	Maintain accurate opportunity tracking, forecasting, and CRM updates in accordance with company expectations. 
•	Work closely with marketing to support lead generation campaigns, conferences, scientific meetings, and customer engagement activities. 
•	Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through timely follow-up and coordination with internal support functions.
requirements:

•	Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Molecular Biology, or a related scientific discipline. 
•	MBA is desirable but not mandatory.
EXPERIENCE
•	6–10 years of commercial experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biopharma, Cell & Gene Therapy, Bioprocessing, or related industries. 
•	Experience in technical sales, business development, application support, or account management within the life sciences market. 
•	Good understanding of Cell & Gene Therapy workflows, including cell culture, gene editing, viral vectors, cell processing, bioprocessing, and analytical technologies. 
•	Experience working with biotechnology companies, pharmaceutical organizations, research institutes, hospitals, or CDMOs is preferred. 
•	Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline and consistently achieve business objectives. 
•	Experience working within a matrix organization is an advantage.

 KEY COMPETENCIES
•	Strong business development and consultative selling skills. 
•	Ability to identify customer needs and position workflow-based solutions. 
•	Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. 
•	Scientific aptitude with the ability to engage technical and commercial stakeholders. 
•	Strong planning, organization, and territory management skills. 
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
•	Customer-focused mindset with a passion for building long-term partnerships. 
•	High level of learning agility and adaptability in a rapidly evolving Cell & Gene Therapy market.

title: Senior Strategic Account Manager
description:
Overview
A Strategic Account Manager owns large regional or national restaurant chains, typically 20+ outlets across multiple cities, often with sophisticated operations teams. These accounts are enterprise-level: they require executive alignment across regions, cross-functional coordination with Swiggy and operations teams, and the ability to think strategically about long-term partnerships.
Key Responsibilities
Own enterprise accounts: Manage 20-30 multi-city chains, each with 20+ outlets generating annual revenue in crores. These accounts are the profit center of the city
Executive partnership: Your primary contacts are executives (franchisors, regional VPs, founders). You are a trusted advisor shaping their Swiggy strategy
Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate with Swiggy central team, operations, and finance teams to deliver custom solutions, integrations, or special programs for accounts
Strategic planning: Develop 6 to 12-month growth plans with accounts. Identify expansion opportunities across new cuisines, formats, and locations. Position Swiggy as core to their growth
Complex deal structuring: Negotiate high-value contracts, custom pricing, exclusive arrangements, and value-add services. You have significant autonomy on deal terms
Enterprise QBRs: Present quarterly business reviews to boards or executive teams. Your presentations need data, insights, and vision for the partnership
Churn prevention: Monitor account growth obsessively. Identify red flags early, escalate issues, and develop retention strategies for at-risk accounts
Market expansion: Identify new restaurant groups entering your market or new formats expanding. Lead high-touch outreach and land transformational accounts
Data mastery: Build predictive models for account health, identify leading indicators of churn, develop ROI calculators for pitches, and forecast quarterly revenue with accuracy
Strategic travel: Travel to account locations and regional hubs 1-2 times per quarter. Occasionally present at franchisee conferences or advisory boards
Executive presence: Your interactions with restaurant executives and internal Swiggy leadership reflect Swiggy's brand. You are a professional partner, not a transactional salesperson
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
4+ years in enterprise account management, strategic sales, or business development at high-growth tech companies
Proven track record in closing and expanding deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships
Exceptional Presentation Skills: The SAM must present enterprise business reports, growth roadmaps, and commercial proposals with clarity, structure, and high confidence. Grade-A executive communication is non-negotiable.
Advanced Analytical Thinking: The role requires the ability to decode complex problem statements from data, identify growth levers, diagnose performance gaps, forecast revenue, and build structured business cases independently.
Ownership & Expansion Mindset: A strong go-getter attitude is essential — someone who thinks beyond transactional account management and proactively identifies expansion, innovation, and partnership opportunities.
30 to 40 in-Person restaurant partner meetings in a month

title: Key Account Management - Assistant Manager - Nearbuy
description:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants, and online platforms. The company is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and financial services. One97 Communications Limited, which owns the Paytm brand, was founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma.
About the Role
We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Key Account Manager focused primarily on hunting and bringing incremental business to the platform. This is a new-business acquisition role rather than a traditional account-maintenance role. The person will identify prospects, build a pipeline, pitch our offerings, negotiate commercials, close new business and deliver measurable monthly revenue.
Key Responsibilities
- Identify and acquire new merchants/accounts through outbound prospecting, market mapping, references, networking and other lead-generation channels.
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects and continuously convert prospects into live business.
- Own the complete sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, pitching, negotiation, closure and onboarding.
- Generate incremental business every month and take complete ownership of the revenue brought in.
- Develop strong understanding of the local market, competitor landscape and merchant opportunities.
- Create prospect-wise action plans to achieve monthly business targets.
- Follow up consistently and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
- Work with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and activation of newly acquired business.
- Maintain accurate sales pipeline, conversion and revenue reporting.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and upselling after initial acquisition.
Performance Expectations
- The role is heavily performance-driven and focused on incremental/new business generation.
- A strong incentive structure will provide high performers the opportunity to earn significantly above their fixed salary through incentives.
Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!
requirements:
Ideal Candidate
- Strong hunting/new-business sales background.
- Demonstrated history of personally generating incremental revenue.
- Comfortable with cold calling, outbound sales and repeated follow-ups.
- Strong prospecting, negotiation and closing skills.
- Highly target-oriented and motivated by performance-linked earnings.
- Able to build a territory and pipeline from scratch.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Comfortable working with numbers and tracking business performance.
- Experience in F&B, hospitality, lifestyle, beauty, local commerce, advertising, or marketplace businesses is an advantage.
Key
Success Metrics
Qualified opportunities created
New merchants/accounts acquired Conversion/closure rate
Monthly incremental business generated
Consistency of monthly business generation
Revenue/incentive contribution
Join Us
A collaborative, output-driven environment that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology.
Opportunities to improve Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) by unlocking massive cross-sell opportunities across Paytm’s user base.
A solid 360 circle feedback culture supported by peer teams aligned with your goals.
