title: Director, Sales Operations & Business Transformation
description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Director, Sales Operations & Business Transformation
Overview of Services
Services is Mastercard's professional services arm, focused on driving value beyond payment transactions. We harness the power of our transaction data, deep payments expertise and vast network of merchant and FI partners to offer holistic solutions to our customers. Our solutions comprise consulting; data insights; marketing services; loyalty and analytics platforms; and more. Discover more at www.mastercardservices.com/en.
Insights and Enablement team strives to drives smarter decisions and operational excellence for Services, by leveraging data and technology.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly strategic and execution-oriented Director to lead the Customer Onboarding transformation agenda across Mastercard Services. This role will be responsible for driving onboarding excellence, operational scalability, platform adoption, automation, process re-engineering, and business intelligence capabilities across the customer onboarding lifecycle.
The Director will partner closely with Sales, Compliance, Product, Technology, and Operations teams to simplify complex business processes, accelerate customer onboarding timelines, enhance data quality, strengthen governance, and deliver an industry-leading onboarding experience to Mastercard’s customers.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Transformation
•	Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Customer Onboarding transformation across Services.
•	Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and optimize onboarding processes across multiple products and business units.
•	Lead digital transformation initiatives, including workflow modernization, CRM enhancements, onboarding platforms, AI solutions, and automation capabilities.
•	Partner with senior leadership to align onboarding capabilities with broader business growth objectives.
Operations Excellence
•	Lead the end-to-end customer onboarding operating model, ensuring efficient, compliant, and scalable execution.
•	Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce onboarding cycle time, improve customer experience, and enhance operational productivity.
•	Establish governance frameworks, operating metrics, and performance management processes for onboarding operations.
•	Drive adoption and optimization of onboarding platforms and supporting technologies.
Cross-functional Leadership
•	Build strong partnerships across Sales, Compliance, Product, Finance, Technology, Risk, and other Operations teams.
•	Lead cross-functional programs involving multiple workstreams, teams, and geographies.
Team Leadership
•	Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of operations, analytics, and transformation professionals.
•	Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and customer-centricity.
________________________________________
All About You
requirements:
Experience
•	10-15 years of experience leading business transformation, operations, consulting, customer onboarding, revenue operations, sales operations, or related functions.
•	Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional transformation initiatives in B2B, technology, financial services, SaaS or consulting environments.
•	Experience working with senior executives and influencing decisions senior levels.
•	Proven track record of leading global or multi-regional programs with measurable business impact.
•	Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and problem-solving abilities.
•	Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
•	Strong people leadership and talent development capabilities.
Functional Expertise
Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
•	Customer Onboarding & Customer Lifecycle Management
•	Revenue Operations / Sales Operations
•	Business Process Re-engineering
•	CRM Platforms (Salesforce preferred)
•	Automation & AI Solutions
•	Analytics and Business Intelligence
•	Program and Portfolio Management
Education
•	Undergraduate degree required.
•	MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: SG Grade- HR Onboarding
description:
About Us – Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants most comprehensive payment services. Pioneer of mobile QR payments revolution in India, today, Paytm is India’s largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment Transactions and Revenue. Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion in India and bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial Services. Paytm enables commerce for small merchants and distributes various financial services offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with financial institutions.
Paytm has been a pioneer in the merchant space by introducing innovative solutions like QR codes to accept payments and Sound-box to recon payments by voice alerts. We are also distributing loans to these partners via our ‘Paytm for Business’ App.
About the Team:  Onboarding & HR Operations (SG-Grade Vertical), you will lead the onboarding function for new joiners, ensuring they receive a seamless, structured, and welcoming start at Paytm. You will manage end-to-end onboarding processes
Location : Noida
Key Responsibilities
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, both physical (if needed) and digital — update HRIS / internal trackers/database for all onboarding activities, and ensure data integrity.
Liaise with internal stakeholders , IT, Payroll/Finance, Hiring Managers, Facility/Office Admin  to ensure smooth onboarding: ation.
Track onboarding progress: new-joiner status, completion of formalities, induction checklist, follow-up on pending items, and provide regular status updates/reports to HR leadership Act as a first point of contact for new hires for any onboarding-related queries or support during their initial days/weeks.
Contribute to continuous improvement of onboarding processes , suggest improvements, update orientation materials/handbooks, implement best practices for better new-hire experience and compliance.
requirements:
Qualifications & Skill
MBA in Human Resources is mandatory.
1-3 years relevant experience in HR operations, onboarding, HR coordination, or generalist HR roles — ideally including some exposure to leading or coordinating onboarding.
Strong verbal and written communication skills — comfortable conducting presentations and interacting with new joiners and multiple departments.
Proven organizational and team-management capabilities — able to manage schedules, coordinate stakeholders, supervise onboarding tasks, and drive timely execution.
Good understanding of HR processes: onboarding, employee lifecycle, HR compliance, employment paperwork — familiarity with local labour laws is a plus.
Hands-on proficiency with HRIS / onboarding software, MS Office or Google Workspace (for trackers, documentation, reporting).
High attention to detail, data-accuracy, and process-orientation.
Comfortable working in a 6-day working structure (as applicable).
Ability to handle confidential / sensitive information with discretion.
Customer-service / people-oriented mindset: empathetic, helpful, and supportive towards new employees — ensuring a smooth, welcoming experience.

Job Title

About the Role
As a
Talent Acquisition Intern (Non-Tech)
, you will play an active role in driving talent identification and engagement across Paytm’s business, sales, operations, and corporate functions. Working closely with recruiters and business stakeholders, you will help source, screen, and coordinate candidates to fuel Paytm’s fast-paced growth.
This role is ideal for a proactive, energetic individual with strong communication skills, high learning agility, and an interest in modern, technology-enabled hiring practices. You will gain hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment operations and candidate management in a high-volume fintech ecosystem.

Candidate Sourcing:
Leverage job boards, social channels, campus databases, and internal platforms to source qualified candidates for business, sales, and enabling function roles.

Market Research:

Utilize modern sourcing tools, AI prompts, and automated communication platforms to speed up top-of-funnel hiring workflows.

Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related fields preferred).

description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.
Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role
Paytm is looking for an energetic, data-driven, and high-impact IT Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team in Noida. In this role, you will own the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for engineering and technology roles across Paytm's core business units.
You will partner closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and HR Business Partners to source, attract, and hire high-caliber technical talent in a fast-paced, high-growth fintech environment. This role matters directly to Paytm’s growth engine: speed of technical execution starts with bringing in top-tier engineering talent who demonstrate strong ownership, business impact, and learning agility.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Talent Acquisition:
Drive the full recruitment lifecycle for software engineering, backend, frontend, infrastructure, data, and mobile engineering roles.
Proactive Sourcing & Pipeline Building:
Utilize advanced sourcing techniques (LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, tech communities, employee referrals, and specialized job portals) to build a robust candidate pipeline for critical engineering demands.
Hiring Manager Partnership:
Collaborate with Engineering Leadership to understand technical requirements, define candidate personas, and align on hiring timelines and assessment criteria.
Candidate Experience:
Ensure a transparent, engaging, and professional candidate journey from initial outreach through technical rounds to offer acceptance and onboarding.
Offer Management & Negotiation:
Conduct salary fitment assessments, negotiate offer packages, and manage post-offer engagement to ensure high offer conversion rates and low drop-outs.
Process & SLA Adherence:
Track key recruitment metrics including time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, channel mix, and pass-through ratios to continuously optimize hiring efficiency.

, Cloud/DevOps, Data Engineering).

title: Growth Management - Merchant Lending (AM/DM)
description:
About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.
About the role:
You will own the campaigns that turn our merchant base into active borrowers. That means designing, launching and optimising multi-channel campaigns that drive loan eligibility checks, applications,disbursals and repeat borrowing among small businesses — kirana stores, retailers, restaurants and service merchants who accept payments on our platform.
You will work closely with Product, Risk, Credit, Analytics, Sales to grow disbursals while keeping acquisition costs in check.
What you will do:
• Own the campaign calendar for merchant lending: new-to-credit acquisition, pre-approved offer activation, top-ups, renewals and win-back of dormant borrowers.
• Plan and run campaigns across push notifications, SMS, WhatsApp, email, in-app banners, IVR/outbound calling and the field sales force.
• Build merchant segments using transaction volumes, tenure, category, geography and eligibility, and tailor offers and messaging to each.
• Design and run A/B tests on creatives, copy, offer framing, timing and channel mix; scale what works and kill what doesn't.
• Track the full funnel — reach, click, eligibility check, application, KYC, sanction, disbursal — and fix the biggest drop-offs with Product and Ops.
• Manage campaign budgets and incentives (cashback, fee waivers, interest-rate offers) against clear CAC and ROI targets.
• Coordinate with lending partners on offer constructs, approved bases and co-branded communication.
• Ensure every communication complies with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, fair-practice codes and partner brand rules (KFS, APR disclosure, no misleading claims).
• Run festive and seasonal pushes (Diwali, wedding season, quarter-ends) when merchant working-capital needs peak.
• Report weekly on campaign performance and share learnings with leadership. Key metrics you will own
• Disbursal volume and count driven by campaigns
• Funnel conversion rates (offer view → application → disbursal)
• Cost per disbursal and campaign ROI
• Repeat / renewal borrowing rate
What we are looking for:
• 4–7 years in growth, lifecycle . Hands-on experience running CRM campaigns on tools such as CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, Braze or Netcore.
• Comfort with data: you can write basic SQL or work fluently with dashboards and Excel to analyse campaign results.
• Strong grasp of experimentation: control groups, sample sizes, incrementality.
• Ability to manage many stakeholders and move fast in a high-ownership environment.

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role:
Job Description We are looking for energetic and self-driven professionals to join our Offline User Growth Team. The role involves identifying growth opportunities across the city, building relationships with merchants, businesses, institutions and communities, and driving on-ground user acquisition initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
 Visit markets, shops, restaurants, cafés, retail outlets and other high-footfall locations to identify growth opportunities.
 Build and manage partnerships with regional/local brands and businesses.
 Identify and develop corporate, college, institutional and community partnerships.
 Engage with merchants, customers and local communities to understand market needs and provide relevant feedback.
 Identify new opportunities for user acquisition, brand visibility and local marketing initiatives.
 Support execution of merchant programmes, college activities, community initiatives and other local campaigns.
 Work closely with internal teams to take identified opportunities from initiation to closure.
 Maintain regular tracking of visits, opportunities, partnerships and execution.

What We’re Looking For:
 Good knowledge of the local market/city.
 Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
 Comfortable with extensive field work and meeting different stakeholders.
 Ability to independently identify opportunities and follow up consistently.
 Good command of the local language.
 Candidates with experience in field sales, business development, partnerships, merchant acquisition, market development or similar roles would be relevant.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Delhi
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
About the Role
At Okta, we believe in choosing the path of high ambition, long-term impact, and constant innovation over the status quo. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will take full ownership of driving growth across your territory by acquiring net-new logos, expanding existing enterprise relationships, and partnering with key regional influencers.
Supported by Okta's ecosystem, you will execute high-impact sales strategies to build pipeline, accelerate deal cycles, and deliver predictable ARR growth. This is an opportunity to lead complex, six-figure enterprise sales from initial engagement through contract execution, positioning Okta as a strategic identity partner.
What You’ll Do
Drive Ambitious Growth:
Consistently deliver against ARR targets to support 40%+ YOY growth by executing a long-term strategy for net-new logo generation.
Land & Expand:
Identify ideal client profiles, uncover new opportunities, and deepen Okta's footprint across enterprise organizations using a Land, Adopt, Expand, and Deepen model.
Orchestrate Complex Enterprise Deals:
Lead end-to-end sales cycles from prospecting through negotiation and closing, framing Okta’s platform around tangible business value.
Put Customers First:
Embody Okta’s core value—
Always Love Our Customers
—by solving genuine business challenges and delivering long-term value over short-term wins.
Leverage the Ecosystem:
Collaborate across internal teams (Solutions Engineering, Business Value Management, Customer Success) and external channel/alliance partners to unlock new opportunities.
Lead with Integrity & Polish:
Engage C-suite stakeholders with active listening, clear communication, and executive presence, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor on Okta's platform.
requirements:
What You’ll Bring
Proven Track Record:
Extensive experience in enterprise cloud software field sales, with a documented history of meeting/exceeding quotas and closing six-figure deals.
Domain Expertise:
Experience selling complex SaaS/Cloud solutions across Identity, Security, Infrastructure Management, App Dev, or Business Applications.
Strategic Sales Mastery:
Experience with consultative selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger) and a track record of thriving in fast-changing, high-growth environments.
Executive Presence:
Strong communication, active listening, and presentation skills needed to engage and negotiate with C-level executives.
Partner-First Mindset:
Proven ability to leverage channel partners and alliance ecosystems to expand reach and accelerate deal velocity.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience); MBA is a plus.

P14555
The Okta Experience
Supporting Your Well-Being
Driving Social Impact
Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community
We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. title: Product Management - Associate Product Manager - Travel.
description:
About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role:
We are looking for early-career Product Managers who are ready to take independent ownership of a product pod or charter. The role involves understanding customer problems, defining product priorities, collaborating with Design and Engineering, launching products, and continuously improving outcomes through data and customer feedback.
This opportunity is ideal for professionals who have built a strong foundation in Product Management within a fast-paced B2C company and are ready to take on greater ownership. Product Analysts who actively influence product decisions and work closely with technology teams are also encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities:
1) Own a product pod or charter with clearly defined customer and business objectives.
2) Identify customer problems through data analysis, user research, market insights, and product funnel analysis.
3) Define product roadmaps, priorities initiatives, and make informed trade-offs.
4) Develop clear product requirements and collaborate with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and Business teams throughout the product lifecycle.
5) Design and run experiments, evaluate outcomes, and scale successful initiatives while maintaining product quality.
6) Track key product metrics and continuously improve the user experience based on data and customer feedback.
7) Leverage AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, documentation, testing, and product development.
8) Take end-to-end accountability for outcomes, proactively identify risks, and navigate ambiguous problem statements.
What We Are Looking For:
1) Around 3–5 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Product Analytics, Business Analysis, or related product roles.
2) Experience in a scaled consumer internet company, high-growth startup, marketplace, commerce, fintech, travel, mobility, or another fast-paced B2C business.
3) Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives with measurable customer or business impact.
4) Strong understanding of product discovery, prioritization, funnel analysis, experimentation, and product delivery.
5) Hands-on experience with Android or iOS products and a strong understanding of user experience.
6) Ability to collaborate directly with Engineering teams and discuss APIs, data flows, release dependencies, and technical trade-offs, including native versus cross-platform development.
7) Strong analytical skills and proficiency in interpreting product metrics, funnels, cohorts, and experiment results.
8) Ability to challenge existing assumptions and make data-driven decisions.
9) A proactive, curious, and adaptable approach to problem-solving.
10) Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions.
11) Practical, regular use of modern AI tools to improve productivity and work quality.
Why Join Us?
Own meaningful product problems and take accountability for outcomes.
Work on products used at scale and collaborate across Product, Technology, Supply, Operations, and Business teams.
Drive product initiatives from discovery to launch and continuous improvement.
Explore opportunities to build new travel propositions from the ground up.
Work in a fast-paced environment that encourages experimentation, independent thinking, and the practical application of AI.
requirements:
Preferred Qualifications:
1) Experience taking a customer problem from discovery and ideation through product launch, with clear evidence of impact.
2) Exposure to high-traffic products, frequent release cycles, complex marketplace dynamics, or conversion-focused product journeys.
3) Experience building prototypes, automating workflows, or using AI beyond basic content generation.
4) Familiarity with AI agents or agentic frameworks is a strong plus.
5) A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another technical discipline is preferred. An MBA is an added advantage but not mandatory.
6) Ability to balance customer value, business impact, speed of execution, and technical feasibility.

title: Manager, India Tax
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for a Manager - India Tax to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager - Tax in the Tax department. In this role, you will drive direct tax compliance and transfer pricing operations for Indian entities, ensure precise TDS calculations and statutory return filings, and maintain rigorous tax reconciliations to support financial accuracy and regulatory integrity across the organization.
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
Undertaking direct tax and transfer pricing compliances for Indian entities
Preparing TDS calculations and ensuring payments are made within due dates
Preparing and ensuring accurate, timely filing of direct tax returns, including TDS returns, APA filings, corporate tax returns, tax audits, and transfer pricing forms
Preparing monthly direct tax reconciliations
Pay Transparency
Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.
Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.
requirements:
Who You Are (Success Profile)
You act like an owner. You take complete accountability for direct tax operations and transfer pricing outcomes, balancing technical strategy with hands-on execution.
You operate with urgency. You thrive in fast-paced environments, managing statutory deadlines and complex tax filings with speed and precision.
You are a problem-solver. You navigate evolving tax regulations and compliance requirements proactively to deliver accurate solutions.
You champion simplicity. You bring clarity and structure to complex financial data, TDS calculations, and monthly reconciliations.
You lead with integrity. You uphold the highest standards of accuracy and regulatory compliance, earning trust through consistent, transparent execution.
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
Chartered Accountant credential with 8-10 years of experience in direct tax compliances and tax returns within a multinational organization
In-depth knowledge of tax accounting, direct tax compliances, and transfer pricing frameworks
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
Proven ability to function effectively in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
Demonstrated proactiveness in project execution and delivery
Exceptional eye for detail across complex tax data and reconciliations

title: Senior Manager - Strategic Partnerships
description:
About the Role
Swiggy is looking for an experienced professional to build and manage strategic partnerships with large institutions, enterprises and key business ecosystems across our priority markets.
The role will involve identifying opportunities, building relationships with senior stakeholders, developing partnership frameworks and working closely with internal teams to create solutions that enhance Swiggy’s presence and engagement across important consumer and business ecosystems.
This is a highly collaborative, stakeholder-facing role requiring strong relationship-building, commercial understanding and the ability to navigate complex organization.
We are looking for someone who is
well-networked, commercially astute and highly effective at building relationships and getting things done
.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, engaging with senior stakeholders and creating partnerships that deliver tangible business outcomes.
Experience across multiple markets, particularly
Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai
, would be an advantage.

Identify and develop strategic relationships with large enterprises, institutions and business ecosystems across key cities.
Build relationships with senior decision-makers and relevant stakeholders across organization.
Understand partner requirements and develop mutually beneficial partnership models.
Lead discussions and negotiations through to closure and implementation.
Work closely with city, operations, commercial, legal and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of partnerships.
Develop a strong understanding of local market dynamics and identify opportunities to strengthen Swiggy’s presence across priority ecosystems.

Track partnership performance and identify opportunities for deeper engagement and expansion.
Represent Swiggy in senior-level external engagements and build long-term institutional relationships.

description:
About Paytm:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About The Team
:
Looking to join the heart of Paytm? Are you someone who loves to build products and also gets curious about technology stack being used? The Payments team is looking for Product Managers to create high impact and critical business products. You will work with business leaders and engineering partners to drive the strategy, roadmap, execution of a product area. Successful product managers are extremely customer focussed, creative thinkers, hustlers who enjoy a high paced environment and to be able to get stuff done.
Role Overview:-
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale Paytm's International Expansion charter. This role requires deep hands-on experience in payment products across acquiring, gateways, banking and card scheme integrations, merchant onboarding, settlement systems and merchant experience.
Key Responsibilities:-
* Own the end-to-end product roadmap for international payments: merchant onboarding, card acceptance, clearing, settlement and payouts, reconciliation, merchant experience.
* Lead integrations with card schemes, onboarding vendors, the card switch, settlement banks, terminal vendors, FX providers and open banking aggregators.
* Design onboarding, settlement, reconciliation, payment, merchant features that meet the regulatory requirements of each market.
* Drive cross-functional execution across product, engineering, compliance, and business teams.
* Work with solution architects and engineering leads, write detailed product requirement documents, and manage roadmaps and deliverables.
* Work with multiple stakeholders, senior management and cross-functional teams to influence quicker decisions and clear technical roadblocks.
Why join us
•A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology·
•Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities·
•A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals·
•Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!
requirements:

* Prior experience in merchant payments and global fintech environments.

title: Account Manager
description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their
respective base locations.
Role Summary -
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned
Responsibilities -
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
About the Team -
Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.
requirements:
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

description:
Job Title: Client Onboarding & Product Specialist
Company:
Paytm
Location:
Noida
Department:
Business / Customer Success / Product
Role Overview
We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused professional to manage the onboarding and adoption journey of new clients at Paytm. The role involves conducting product demos, guiding clients through setup and integrations, resolving onboarding challenges, and ensuring smooth adoption of Paytm’s solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Support, and Product teams.
Key Responsibilities
Lead new clients through a smooth and structured onboarding process, ensuring successful product setup and activation.
● Conduct product demos, product tours, and personalized training sessions to help clients understand and effectively use Paytm’s solutions.
● Guide clients through
WhatsApp Marketing integrations
, campaign setup, and relevant product functionalities.
● Act as the primary point of contact during onboarding, addressing setup-related queries and troubleshooting issues to ensure a seamless experience.
● Monitor client adoption and proactively identify opportunities to improve product usage and engagement.
● Simplify complex product or technical processes and help clients move from initial onboarding challenges to confident product usage.
● Collaborate with Sales, Customer Support, and Product teams to resolve client issues and share actionable customer feedback.
● Track onboarding progress, client requirements, and issue resolution while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
● Monitor campaign performance and support clients in optimizing their multi-channel campaigns.
● Identify recurring client challenges and work with internal teams to improve processes, product experience, and onboarding journeys.
● Maintain accurate records of client interactions, onboarding status, feedback, and resolutions.
Key
requirements:
Skills
● Strong verbal and written communication skills.
● Customer-centric approach with strong relationship-building abilities.
● Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
● Ability to conduct product demonstrations and training sessions.
● Understanding of SaaS products, CRM, digital marketing, or WhatsApp-based marketing solutions is preferred.
● Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
● Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities while meeting SLAs.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Preferred Experience
● 1+ years of experience in
Customer Success, Client Onboarding, SaaS, Product Support, Account Management, or related roles
.
● Experience working with digital marketing, WhatsApp Business, CRM, or SaaS platforms will be an added advantage.

Company: Paytm 
Location: Noida 
Department: Business / Customer Success / Product 
Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused professional to manage the onboarding and adoption journey of new clients at Paytm. The role involves conducting product demos, guiding clients through setup and integrations, resolving onboarding challenges, and ensuring smooth adoption of Paytm’s solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Support, and Product teams. 
Key Responsibilities 
 Lead new clients through a smooth and structured onboarding process, ensuring successful product setup and activation. 
● Conduct product demos, product tours, and personalized training sessions to help clients understand and effectively use Paytm’s solutions. 
● Guide clients through WhatsApp Marketing integrations, campaign setup, and relevant product functionalities. 
● Act as the primary point of contact during onboarding, addressing setup-related queries and troubleshooting issues to ensure a seamless experience. 
● Monitor client adoption and proactively identify opportunities to improve product usage and engagement. 
● Simplify complex product or technical processes and help clients move from initial onboarding challenges to confident product usage. 
● Collaborate with Sales, Customer Support, and Product teams to resolve client issues and share actionable customer feedback. 
● Track onboarding progress, client requirements, and issue resolution while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs. 
● Monitor campaign performance and support clients in optimizing their multi-channel campaigns. 
● Identify recurring client challenges and work with internal teams to improve processes, product experience, and onboarding journeys. 
● Maintain accurate records of client interactions, onboarding status, feedback, and resolutions.
Key Skills 
● Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
● Customer-centric approach with strong relationship-building abilities. 
● Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. 
● Ability to conduct product demonstrations and training sessions. 
● Understanding of SaaS products, CRM, digital marketing, or WhatsApp-based marketing solutions is preferred. 
● Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills. 
● Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities while meeting SLAs. 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 

Preferred Experience ● 1+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, SaaS, Product Support, Account Management, or related roles. 
● Experience working with digital marketing, WhatsApp Business, CRM, or SaaS platforms will be an added advantage.

title: Talent Acquisition- Tech Hiring
description:
About Paytm:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition professional with strong experience in Tech Hiring and volume recruitment. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience hiring across technology roles, managing multiple positions simultaneously, and delivering on high-volume hiring mandates in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities:
* Own end-to-end recruitment for Tech roles across various levels and skill sets.
* Manage volume hiring and multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, databases and other channels.
* Screen profiles and conduct initial HR discussions to assess candidate fit.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements and drive closures.
* Coordinate and manage bulk hiring drives, walk-ins and weekend hiring drives as required.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of relevant tech talent.
* Ensure timely interview scheduling, feedback tracking and candidate follow-ups.
* Manage offer discussions, candidate engagement and joining follow-ups.
* Maintain recruitment MIS, trackers and hiring dashboards.
* Work on improving sourcing strategies and turnaround time for high-volume requirements.
Why join us:
We support our people by providing a range of flexible working options so they can work in the way that best suits them. We also offer you the opportunity to develop your career, working in a diverse and inclusive workplace where the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated and create a great place to grow, thrive and belong. Most importantly, for us Work is Fun!!
requirements:
Key Skills & Experience
* 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with strong exposure to Tech Hiring.
* Hands-on experience hiring for technology roles in a volume / fast-paced recruitment environment.
* Experience handling multiple tech requirements simultaneously.
* Strong sourcing skills across LinkedIn, Naukri and other recruitment platforms.
* Good understanding of technology roles and basic technical skill requirements.
* Strong candidate engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing hiring drives and bulk recruitment initiatives.
* Strong communication, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Ability to work with tight timelines and manage high-volume hiring targets.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.
What We’re Looking For:
Someone who is hands-on, target-oriented and proactive, with the ability to manage high-volume Tech hiring independently while maintaining a strong candidate experience and stakeholder connect.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
With Swiggy's New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
Job Responsibilities:
Initiate partnerships with new accounts and actively manage existing relationships, being their P.O.C. for Swiggy Sustaining and growing the relationships which translates to a growth in revenue for the city
Maintaining a strong relationship with restaurant owners (Specifically Key Accounts of the City & Country) and advising them on issues related to the market and offering solutions on the same
Conduct promotional events & marketing activation, primarily BTL, in conjunction with the internal teams Manage the sales administration function, and operational performance reporting, streamlining processes and systems wherever possible and advising senior management on maximizing business relationships and creating an environment where customer service can flourish, also managing a huge team
Responsible for training new recruits, especially Sales Managers, and mentoring them
Desired Skill Set:
Graduate with 5-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management
A competent decision-maker with the ability to develop, own and build a strategic plan for ensuring the best restaurants partner with us
Effective communication skills with Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life Should be able to lead and mentor the team
Identifies builds and uses a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach
Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence for change to increase the effectiveness and success on campaigns
Creativity & Initiative - demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward

title: Campaign Management- Traffic Management- Growth
description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive CLM Operations candidate to join the Paytm Campaign Lifecycle Management (CLM) team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end execution of off-deck and on-deck campaigns across multiple channels using CleverTap. You will collaborate closely with Category, Growth, and Traffic teams to ensure campaigns are set up
accurately, approved on time, and monitored for performance.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Campaign Execution & Management
• Create, configure, and publish campaigns on CleverTap across Push (Override, Lifecycle, Nodedupe, Event-based), Email, SMS,
Chat, and WhatsApp channels.
• Set up and manage CleverTap Journeys, including event-based triggers, audience
segmentation, and multi-step flows.
• Set up and validate context strings for both Override and Lifecycle on-deck campaigns (Native
Display).
2. Data Fetching & Validation
• Fetch and validate campaign base sizes using CleverTap's segment builder and cross-
reference against push campaign base size checks.
• Validate Banner IDs, deeplinks (via QR code generation), widget types, slot IDs, and image
specs before campaign scheduling.
• Monitor campaign delivery metrics post-launch; flag anomalies such as unusual drop in reach or
delivery rates (expected benchmark: 50–60% delivery/acquiry).
• Pull and verify data from the Campaign Tracker, Traffic Approval Sheet, and Allocation Team
Sheet to ensure alignment.
• Ensure all campaigns have a valid Label ID from the CLM Category List, and that CategoryId
and CategoryName key-value pairs are correctly mapped (case-sensitive).
3. Quality Control & Scheduling
• Perform QC checks as per the Campaign SOP before scheduling any campaign.
• Conduct banner QC in line with Banner SOP guidelines, verifying image specs, deeplinks, and
widget types.
• Test campaigns during permitted testing hours (7:00 AM–10:00 PM) using the designated test
webhook.
Required Skills & Qualifications
1. CleverTap Expertise (Mandatory)
• Hands-on experience with CleverTap for campaign creation, audience segmentation, and
channel configuration.
• Proficient in setting up Events and Journeys in CleverTap, including multi-step flows, event
triggers, and user property filters.
• Understanding of CleverTap concepts: Native Display, Push campaigns, cascade mode, sub-
contexts, frequency capping, and DND settings.
• Familiarity with webhook configuration (live and test) for Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and
Chat channels.
2. Data Fetching & Analytical Skills
• Ability to fetch, validate, and cross-reference campaign data from multiple trackers and sheets
(Google Sheets / Excel).
• Basic understanding of segmentation logic: user properties, behavioral filters, segment
exclusions, and frequency rules.
• Ability to identify and flag data discrepancies or campaign mismatches quickly and accurately.
3. Operational & Process Skills
• Strong attention to detail — ability to follow multi-step SOPs precisely and maintain zero-miss
campaign execution.
• Experience raising and tracking tickets on Jira or similar tools
• Good time management skills to handle approval deadlines, testing windows, and scheduling
timelines simultaneously.
Why join us?
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

title: Growth Management - Telco I Experience 2-4 Years
description:
About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Team:
Our Key Offerings are divided into 5 broad categories as follows:
• Entertainment
• Digital Platforms
• CVM Solutions
• Enterprise Services
• Financial Platforms
One97 has the widest and largest deployment of telecom applications on cloud platforms in India and has a myriad of VAS services that have helped operators augment their revenue even in complex markets like India, SAARC, Middle East, Africa and many more
Role Overview:
We are looking for a data-driven Growth to support our mobile app and SuperApp ecosystem. The role combines analytical rigor with hands-on execution, focusing on user acquisition, retention, engagement, and GTM strategy optimization. The ideal candidate will be comfortable analyzing campaigns, evaluating go-to-market plans, and identifying actionable opportunities for growth.
Key Responsibilities:
*
Growth Analysis & Insights:
-Analyze campaign performance (push notifications, in-app messages, email,
SMS, partnerships) and track conversion KPIs.
-Monitor retention, reactivation, and engagement metrics, including feature
adoption, transaction frequency, and monetization flows.
-Conduct funnel and cohort analyses to identify bottlenecks in user journeys
and growth opportunities.
-Track campaign ROI, cost per acquisition (CPA), activation rate, referral
conversion, and other key growth indicators.
*
GTM Strategy Support:
-Assist in designing, executing, and analyzing go-to-market plans for new
features, wallet flows, or app integrations.
-Evaluate the effectiveness of promotional campaigns, incentive programs,
and partnerships in driving adoption.
-Monitor competitive offerings and market trends to optimize GTM timing,
messaging, and channel strategy.
*
Campaign Execution & Optimization:
-Support A/B testing and experimentation for messaging, incentives, and
feature launches.
-Recommend optimizations based on campaign performance and user
behavior insights.
-Collaborate with product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure growth
initiatives are aligned with overall strategy.
*
Reporting & Documentation:
-Prepare clear, actionable reports highlighting growth insights, GTM
performance, and recommended strategies.
-Maintain dashboards for campaign KPIs, GTM success metrics, and feature
adoption.
-Document learnings from experiments and campaigns for continuous
improvement.
requirements:
Key Skills & Requirements:
● 2–4 years of experience in Growth, Product Growth, Digital Marketing, CRM,
Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, or a similar role.
● Strong understanding of customer funnels and growth metrics.
● Experience in planning and executing customer campaigns.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
● Good understanding of customer segmentation and lifecycle marketing.
● Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets and dashboards.
● Basic understanding of GA4, Looker Studio, or other analytics tools is
preferred.
● Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
● Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
● Strong ownership and execution mindset.

title: Sales Manager II
description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
